For You have redeemed for God,
By the blood that You shed,
People from each tribe and tongue
And nations too.
(Revelation 5: 13)
I heard every creature,
In heaven and earth,
And those under the earth;
And those in the seas,
Singing out their praises,
To Him who's on the throne,
Be honour and glory,
For ever and ever.
(Revelation 7: 9)
All dressed up in white robes,
With palms in their hands,
Crying out with a loud voice,
Before the throne,
Salvation belongs to our God
Who sits on the throne,
Salvation to Jesus
The Lamb that was slain.
To You then our Lord and King,
We offer our lives,
To bring in a billion souls,
In that multitude,
Accept then our talents,
Our time and our money,
Our strength and our labours,
And count on us, Lord.

hymns.title: God Answers Prayers in His Time
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald. World University of Prayer and Fasting. Koume, 27th February 2016.

lines: God answers prayer,
In His time,
When He does,
It's so good.
If you have to pray for 10 long years.
God will answer you,
If you have to pray for twenty years.
God will answer you.
If like the widow! You have to pray.
God will answer you.
If we must pray for a long, long time.
God will answer us.
If you have to pray like George Muller.
God will answer you.
If things get worse as you pray and pray.
God will answer you.
If you see no change, as you pray.
God will answer you.
He's told us to pray, and ne'er give up.
God will answer us.
He has asked us to importune Him.
For He'll answer us!

hymns.title: God Is Going to Answer All Our Prayers
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF World University of Prayer and Fasting For those in the Prayer Ministry.

lines: God will surely answer all of our prayers (2x)
After interceding for so long
Jesus will surely answer all our prayers.
God will surely answer all of your prayers (2x)
After interceding for so long
Jesus will surely answer all your prayers.
Oh, pray for your health,
Without giving up.
Oh, pray for your wife,
And your family.
For your husband, pray!
Your family too!
For your children, pray!
Stubborn as they are.
Even if you doubt,
Pray for God will hear.
Oh, pray for the lost,
The backsliders too.
For your assembly, pray!
Your locality.
Pray for all your friends,
And your neighbours too.
Even when you see,
No change as you pray.
If the worst happens,
Oh, just pray and pray.
He will surely come and bring us all comfort, (2x)
After interceding for so long,
Jesus will surely come and wipe all our tears.

hymns.title: We Praise Your Name
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF WUPF for those who are in the Prayer Ministry. Koume, 27th February 2016.

lines: We praise Your name,
O Lord Jesus,
We praise Your name,
For Your pro-mi-ses,
We praise Your name!
For heaven our home,
We praise Your name,
For our heavenly home.
Heaven is the Father's home
Beautiful and Bright like a pearl
It's full of glory and full of light
Ex-qui-si-te! It's like a gem.
Heaven is a place of joy,
No sin! and, nothing impure,
There is worship, praise and there is love
And the presence of our Lord!
While we labour here on earth
With all the conflict and pain,
The thought of our Father's home gives us joy
As we yearn and wait for it.
Welcome to our glory home
The city of God, our home!
Where Jesus the Christ will welcome us
Come into the Father's joy.
You are Alpha and Omega!
The Beginning and the End,
To him who's thirsty you'll surely give,
The water! Water of life.
Surely Jesus is the Christ,
The Messiah! The Anointed,
The Bread of life! Yes that's who You are
You've satisfied us with love.
Jesus, we await Your return
You are the Love of our hearts,
O Lord we wait fo-r the trumpet sound
Come and take us to Yourself.

hymns.title: A Glorious Sunset
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. 4th September 2017.

lines: From the Heavens a beautiful sight,
A glorious sunset, so wonderful,
And the colours of fire shine on us,
It is our Fath-er who made it all.
Lift your voices in praise, you people,
Tis so good! Tis so good!
All His angels in heaven, praise Him,
'Tis so good! Tis so good!
From of old, the Lord God, Creator,
In His unchanging, great faithfulness,
Causes the sun to rise from the East
And brings the sunset there in the West.
All the trees evergreen that we see
How well they contrast against the clouds
All the sun rays that go down to sleep.
They all amaze us by their beauty.
When I see in the brothers right here,
And all around me, the sisters too,
Hearts liberated by Jesus from sin,
The Spirit's beauty, we all can see.
Lai-lai-lai-lai-lai-lai (2x)
'Tis so good! 'Tis so good!
Lai-lai-lai-lai-lai-lai (2x)
'Tis so good! 'Tis so good!

hymns.title: The New Jerusalem
hymns.author: World University of Prayer and Fasting, For those in the Prayer Ministry. Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. (Tune: I've reached the land of corn and wine)

lines: (John 14: 1)
The Lord Jesus has said to us,
I'm going to prepare you a place,
I'm coming back to take you home,
To take you home along with me.
He's coming back (2x)
The Lord Jesus has promised us,
He's coming back (2x)
He is faithful, He's said to us,
He's coming back, (2x)
To take us home to be with Him.
(Revelation 21: 1)
Behold I looked and there I saw,
A new Heaven and a new earth,
The first Heaven and earth had passed,
Even the sea had disappeared.
(Revelation 21: 2)
The New Jerusalem I saw,
The holy city coming down,
Out of Heaven from God prepared,
A beautiful bride for her groom.
Jerusalem, (2x)
The holy city, from above,
Jerusalem, (2x)
Coming from heaven from the Lord,
Jerusalem, (2x)
It is our home forever more.
(Revelation 21: 4)
He'll wipe every tear from our eyes,
And death and pain will be no more,
An end to crying and mourning,
Yes, these old things will pass away.
(Revelation 21: 19)
The foundations of the city walls,
Were all adorned with precious stones,
Jasper, sapphire, chalcedony,
With em-e-rald and sardonyx.
(Revelation 21: 20)
The city walls, they were adorned,
With carnelian and chrysolite,
Beryl, topaz and chrysoprase,
With jacinth and with amethyst.
(Revelation 21: 23)
The city does not need the sun,
Or need the moon to shine on it,
The glory of God gives it light,
Jesus the Lamb becomes its lamp.

hymns.title: The Road to Intimacy
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald 6th September 2017. (Tune: When we walk with the Lord)

lines: If you love Me you'll keep
The commands that give,
Then the Holy Spirit will fill you
I'll pray to my Father,
So that each one of you
May receive the gift of My Spirit.
Jesus promised
That for all who obey,
Will receive from the Father
The gift of His Spirit.
Do you want to be close?
And intimate with God?
Live a life of obedience to Him.
For He'll give His Spirit,
Without partia-li-ty,
For all who obey and fear Him.
In-ti-ma-cy
With the God who's holy
Is avai-la-ble to all,
All who will obey Him.
He who keeps my commands
And obeys them, loves Me,
This one will be loved by My Father.
With a deep special love,
And yes, I'll love him too,
And I will reveal Myself to him.
In-ti-ma-cy,
With the God who's holy
Only grows and gets deeper;
For the one who obeys.
Jesus has said to us
If anyone loves me,
Then, that one will obey my teaching;
My Father will love him,
And we will come to him,
And with him we will make o-ur home.
When the Lord commands us
To do that which He wants,
Our obedience will be for our good;
For each time we obey,
It causes us to grow,
To grow in our knowledge of the Lord.
There are so many depths
Of the Lord we can know,
We can grow and get deeper with Him
New horizons in our
Relationships with Him,
Simply keeping the Word of God.
In-ti-ma-cy
With the Lord that you have,
Can be measured and tested,
By how you treat His Word.

hymns.title: The New Covenant
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF Koume, 5th March 2016. (Tune: "Blessed be the Fountain of blood")

lines: (Revelation 5:9-10)
Jesus by the blood that You shed,
Has purchased for God the Father
A people who belong to God;
Who live for God here on this earth!
A people who have God for Fa-ther,
And Jesus is their Lord and Master,
People who are kings and are priests,
And obey God's laws from their hearts.
Glorious! New covenant! (2x)
Sealed with the blood of the Lamb
Has made us the people of God.
Glorious! New covenant (2x)
Sealed with the blood of the Lamb
And has made God to be our God.
(Ephesians 6: 10)
Jesus by the blood that You shed
Has purchased for God the Father,
A people who're born from above,
And who spread His reign on this earth.
They are clothed with God's very armour
To resist the wiles of the devil;
Victoriously they're moving on,
As they wait the return of the Lord.
(Hebrew 8: 10)
This is the covenant I will make
With the house of Isra-el,
This is the covenant I will make
After those days sai-th the Lord.
I will put my laws into their minds,
Also, on the hearts I will write them;
I will be to them their God,
And to me they'll be My people.
(Hebrew 8: 11-12)
None will need to teach his fellows
Nor will they need to teach their kin,
None will have to say "know the Lord"
For each of them will know the Lord.
From the least to the greatest will know Me
With full knowledge they all will know their God
I'll forgive their iniquities!
And their sins I'll remember no more.
(1 Peter 2:9)
Yes, we are a chosen people,
And we are a royal priesthood!
A holy nation! Yes, we are!
Bought for God with that precious blood.
To declare the praises of ou-r God,
Who called each one out of deep darkness,
Into His own wonderful light,
Celebrate! The name of Jesus.
(Revelation 5:9)
Jesus by Your Preci-ous blood,
Has purchased for God Your Father,
Men from every tribe on the earth
Every language, race, and nation.
They sing with loud voices before the throne:
"You are worthy to take the scroll, Lord!
And to break the seals upon it.
For You are the One who was slain".
(Revelation 5: 12)
Jesus how wonderful You are!
You are worthy Lord our God,
You are worthy to be adored,
Here on earth and up in heaven.
Receive power! Receive all the riches,
And receive all honour and wisdom,
Receive blessings, glory and might,
Thou the Lamb who is on the throne.

hymns.title: What God Does Lasts Forever
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald 4th September 2017.

lines: (Psalm 90: 2)
The Lord our God is the true God,
And there is no other one like Him.
He made the Heavens and the Earth,
Yes, there is no other one like Him.
Now and forever He is God,
There is no other God but Him,
He is the Lord, the only God,
Yes, there is no other God like Him.
As for man his days are like grass,
He flourishes like field flowers,
And then the wind blows over them,
They're no more; they're gone and gone.
What is made looks like its maker,
The work of each one bears their marks,
What God has made is forever,
The works of man all pass away.
(Ecclesiastes 3: 1-4)
Everything o-ur Lord has made,
Will last forever and ever
No, there is nothing we can add,
Or anything to take away.
What God has made is forever,
The things of man will pass away,
The things of man will pass away,
What God has made is forever.
Man is mortal and all he does,
Even around him soon will pass,
But because God lives forever
All that He does is forever.
What G-od do-es through a man
Is in response to prayer,
Yes, what God do-es through a man,
Is as a re-sponse to fasting!
All of the things we accomplish,
Could be attractive in men's eyes,
But then, what will be their value?
When we look at eternity.
You have to pray for conversions,
The Holy Spirit will convict,
Revealing Jesus to these souls,
And then, these converts will abide.
All of the churches that you plant,
By prayer and by fasting,
These are churches that will stand strong,
For what God does lasts forever.

hymns.title: The Church, She Prays
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting 4th September 2017. (Tune: Sweet hour of prayer, sweet hour of prayer)

lines: (1 Timothy 2: 1)
The church does pray, the church does pray,
For it is her priority,
The church does pray, the church does pray,
For th-is is the will of God,
All other things are second place,
Money and ev-en preaching,
What she must do, her job on earth,
It is to pray, the chu-rch prays.
(1 Timothy 2: 2)
I urge you the-n, first of all,
Believers should lift up to God,
The prayers of supplication,
And thanksgiving to God for all,
For all those in authority,
So that it might be granted us,
Pe-aceful and quiet lives,
in godliness and holiness.
If we want all men to be saved
The church has to get to prayer,
Because for all men to be saved
Our Lord Jesus Christ had to die.
The will of God o-ur Father,
Is that all men on earth be saved!
The church on earth must play her part
Her role, her place is at prayer.
The church, the bride of Jesus Christ,
That He acquired on the cross;
Must work to ensure the success,
Of the plans of her bri-degroom
It's praying that makes her able.
In praying she becomes faithful,
To Christ who prays while on the throne
The church does pray, the church does prays!
The mo-st important meeting,
Of every church that is normal;
Is the meeting of pra-yer!
The most important activity.
If there's a church that doesn't pray,
God will deny them, for He said,
My house will be a house of prayer
A house of prayer for all nations.
The prayer of the church is rich,
And nothing else can take its place.
It's prayer that's so composite,
That nothing can ever surpass.
And when the church comes together,
The Lord is right there in their midst.
Yes, when the church, the Lord's church prays
The Lord reveals Himself to her.
All churches of the Lord must pray,
Praying for men as God demands.
It's their responsibility,
Pray-ing for their localities.
This is the work, the work of prayer,
This is the programme of pray-er,
This is the budget of pray-er,
This is the chur-ch's plan of prayer.
The pray-er of the church must be
A goal-directed focused prayer.
We have to pray and pray for kings,
For all those in authority.
So-ci-ety is shaped by prayer,
By the prayers o-f the church.
If there be crime, an-y violence,
It's because the church doesn't pray.
The bride does pray, the bride does pray,
To be indeed a helper fit.
The head is Jesus Christ, the Lord,
The head prays and the body prays.
The church does pray, the church does pray
O Lord, reveal these things to us,
The church does pray, the church does pray
And when she prays, she pleases God.
Raise for Yourself Lord Jesus Christ
Churches that pray unceasingly.
Raise for Yourself Lord Jesus Christ
Churches that pray and intercede.
Revive us Lord, revive us, Please,
Rend then Heavens and transform us
Reveal to us by Your Spirit,
Befor' all things, the chu-rch prays.

hymns.title: Women Who Pray
hymns.author: World University of Prayer and Fasting. Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh. (Tune: "Sweet hour of prayer.")

lines: (2 Timothy 2: 9)
Women who pray, (2x)
They must be dressed with decency,
With piety and modesty,
Their ornaments are made of these.
The way they appear before men,
Their external attractiveness,
Has ceased to be their idol,
They live in utter simplicity.
(2 Timothy 2: 10)
Worldly women are pre-occupied
With their physical appearance,
Women who pray are pre-occupied
With the character of their lives.
Women who pray have been set free
From vanity and vain glory,
What they pursue as true beauty
Is inner wealth and character.
(2 Timothy 2: 10)
Noisy and talkative women
Are ugly and they displease God.
Those who are sharp-tongued when they speak
Are disagreeable before Him.
Do you want to pray, then count your words!
Stop scolding and stop opposing,
For this will do you so much good,
God loves women whose words are few.
(2 Timothy 2: 10)
Women who pray, women who pray
Need to be beautiful before God,
Women who pray, women who pray,
Must decorate their hearts for God.
With a pure heart, and with good deeds
The inner beauty of women
Who want to pray and worship God,
Is rather the beauty of the heart.
Every woman who wants to pray,
Must confront a critical choice.
Every woman who wants to pray,
She must pursue a unique goal.
Those who desire to attract men,
Have eliminated themselves.
Excluded from God's presence
And they wasted all their lives.
(1 Timothy 2: 9)
Women who pray, women who pray,
Spend very little for their needs.
Women who pray, women who pray
Have killed unholy desire:
To be objects of great expense,
By their husbands or other men.
Women who pray, women who pray
Concentrate their attention on God.
(1 Timothy 2:9)
If you want to be a woman who prays
A worshipper of the living God,
You must then choose to spend your years,
On God and also on His children.
To want to spend much on yourself
And accumulate worldly things,
These things will fill and choke your heart
They will destroy the spirit of prayer.
Yes, in a deliberate way
The woman who desires to pray,
Must always rid herself of all
That is beyond her basic needs.
If you want to have a burden,
Then you must learn to give and give
And keep only the essentials
Too many things kill the burden.
(1 Timothy 2: 10)
Women who pray, women who pray
They must be full of go-od deeds,
Kindness and hospitality,
T'wards relatives and visitors.
Women who pray, must also pray
That God should send his chil-dren
To eat their food and use what they own
They need this so that they can pray.

hymns.title: You Must Be Holy for I'm Holy
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. 5th March 2016. (Tune: "My hope is built on nothing less.")

lines: (Ephesians 1: 3-4)
Praise to the God and the Father
Of Jesus Christ our Lord in whom,
We're blessed with spiritual blessings
In heavenly realms in Jesus Christ.
Even before He made the world,
The Lord had elected us in Christ,
Oh, brethren that we should become,
Blameless and pure before the Lord.
(Ephesians 2: 10)
We are God's workmanship in Christ,
To do the good work He desired,
That God had prepared in advance
For us to do while here on earth.
(Ephesians 2: 10)
The people of C.M.F.I.
In the nations where'er they're found,
Are part of God's own workmanship,
To do His work for God's own praise.
(Romans 6: 11-13)
And so, you must now see yourselves,
As people who are dead to sin,
Consider yourselves dead to evil,
Living for God in Jesus Christ.
(Romans 6: 12, 1 Peter 1: 16)
Oh, do no longer let sin reign,
In your members, Oh, my brethren
No longer obey their desires
The sinful lusts of your body.
Be holy then for I'm holy,
I am your God th' Eternal One,
Be holy then for I'm holy,
I am your God th' Eternal One.
(Romans 6: 14)
No longer give yourself to wrong,
Living as instruments of sin,
Sin must no longer reign o'er you,
Or be your master, My beloved.
(Romans 6: 14)
Present yourself to God as men,
Who have passed from death unto life,
Completely give yourself to God,
As instruments of righteousness.

hymns.title: Costly Hour of Prayer
hymns.author: Henriette Mbarga, Translated by WUPF 5th Prayer and Fasting Crusade. Koume, 2nd December 2013. (Tune: «Sweet hour of prayer. »)

lines: Oh, such a costly hour of prayer,
When Jesus in his days on earth,
Before his Father went to pray,
With loud cries and with te-ars too.
Jesus Christ told a parable
To His assembled disciples.
To show that one must always pray
Yes, one must pray and not give up.
Oh, such a costly hour of prayer
When Jesus prayed with deep anguish.
And his sweat just like drops of blood
Fell one by one upon the earth.
Oh, such a costly hour of prayer
When o-our Lord was forced to ask,
His disciples and Peter too,
Could you not watch with me one hour?
Oh, such a costly hour of prayer
When fasting has advanced quite much.
And one is tired and needs some rest
Meanwhile there's still the need to pray.
Oh, such a costly hour of prayer
When we are overwhelmed with sleep,
A thick veil just descends on us,
But we must continue to pray.
Oh, such a costly hour of prayer
When in our bones we feel the cold.
As if it's whispering; go to bed
But Jesus says: you need to pray,
Oh, such a costly hour of prayer
When the presence of God departs.
Inspite of all we just press on,
Being certain that the Lord does hear.
Inspite of all, keep pressing on,
Both day and night, let's watch and pray.
Just like the army of Gideon,
Tired but still pursuing on.

hymns.title: The Names of the Lord Jesus
hymns.author: Translated on the 12th March 2016.

lines: Each of the names of Jesus has
A distinct role,
Of that which God has preserved
For each one of us.
Jesus is the Saviour
Of all humanity.
And you shall give him the name: "Jesus"
For He will save His people,
From all of their sin.
Hallelujah, amen.
Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah,
Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah, amen.
Each of the names of Jesus has
A distinct role,
Of that which God has preserved
For each one of us.
Jesus Christ said to us: "I am the
Good Shepherd"
And He laid down His life for all the sheep
Jesus is also known as the Chief Shepherd,
Hallelujah, amen.
Each of the names of Jesus has
A distinct role,
Of that which God has preserved
For each one of us.
Jesus Christ is the Lord and we are
His servants,
We must obey Him then in everything.
Be totally consumed to do only
His will,
Hallelujah, amen.
Each of the names of Jesus has
A distinct role,
Of that which God has preserved
For each one of us.
He is the Bread of life!
He is the Teacher too.
He is the Way! The Truth! He is the Life!
The Doorway to the sheep!
That's who Jesus Christ is!
Hallelujah, amen.
Jesus is Lord!
is another of His sweet names!
He is exalted by God o'er the universe,
So, we submit to Him!
Because Jesus is Lord
The Father has highly exalted Him,
In heaven and on earth there's
None like unto Him,
Hallelujah, amen.
Jesus is Master!
Another of His sweet names!
He is th' Anointed of God,
And was sent by God.
Yes, Jesus is the Christ!
Son of the Living God
The Messiah! And the King of kings,
Jesus is also called,
The Bright and Morning Star
Hallelujah, amen.
Emmanuel!
That is another name of Jesus Christ.
It means "God with us"
Our Lord is so very near.
The presence of the Lord
Is with us every where,
At home, at work, even in the market place!
Twenty-four hours a day,
The Lord is right with us.
Hallelujah, amen.
Reveal to us Lord, the roles
Of the names of Christ.
Open our eyes to the wealth that
Each name contains.
And grant to us, God
To have with Jesus Christ
The relationship we must have with Him
A life yielded to Him!
And filled with His love!
Hallelujah, amen.

hymns.title: Our God
hymns.author: Translated by Emilia Tendo WUPF for leaders. Koume, 25th March 2014. (Tune: "The name of Jesus is so sweet.")

lines: Th' Eternal God is ou-r God,
The God of heaven and the earth.
The universe's Creator,
We proclaim loud His great name.
This God upon whom we call,
The God in whom we believe,
Th' Eternal God, that is His name
Our God, He is the true God.
God of Abr'aham! God of Isaac,
Before whom Abraham did walk.
The Fear of Isaac! That's our God,
We proclaim loud His great name.
God of Isaac, God of Jacob,
God who appeared unto Jacob,
Eternal God! You are our strength,
Here we exalt Your great name.
God of Israel, God Almighty,
The God of Bethel! That's Your name,
God El-Elo-He Israel,
Here we exalt Your great name.
The Lord, the God of the Hebrews,
Lord, You are God, the Lord Most High,
You fill the heavens and the earth
Here, we exalt Your great name.
Lord God, The God of every grace,
O God, The One and Only God,
Lord God, The Great and awesome God,
We proclaim loud Your great name.
Lord God Almighty, You are God,
The Object of all ou-r praise,
From everlasting You are God,
We proclaim loud Your great name.
Is-ra-el's King, Her Redeemer!
Lord God! You are our Saviour too,
O Lord our God, You are the Lord,
We glorify Your great name.
You are the Lord, Lord God of Hosts,
You are the Lord, O God Our Rock,
You are the First, You are the Last,
Here we exalt Your great name.
The day of Christ's resurrection,
He said to the ones He loved,
I'm going to My Father and yours,
To My God and to your God.
The Father and God of Jesus,
Is now our Father and our God,
We have the life of God in us,
Th' Eternal God is our God.
Let's bring to God unceasing praise,
Worship and sacrifice of praise,
From hearts and lips that bear His name,
Join all the ransomed in praise.

hymns.title: Jesus Christ Is Our All
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. 7th September 2017. (Tune: "My hope is built on nothing less.")

lines: Jesus Christ is our all in all,
And everything does hold in Him,
He is the greatest gift from God,
Jesus Christ is above all things.
Seated at the right hand of God,
Exalted to the highest place. (3x)
It pleased God the Father that
He be exalted in perfection,
By the suffering that He endured,
The prince of o-ur salvation.
Let's then approach the throne of grace,
To receive mercy and find grace,
Our weaknesses He bears with us,
He's ever ready to help us.
Jesus is seated on the throne
He is the so-ve-reign High Priest. (3x)
During the days of Christ on earth,
He offered pra-yers, petitions,
Loud cries and tears with submissions,
To Him who could save Him from death.
Jesus, forever You're the Priest
You're the High Priest in the Heavens. (3x)
Jesus Christ is the Word of God,
That brings us light and gives us life,
Yes, read the Word with all your heart,
Ready to submit and obey.
There's nothing hidden from Your eyes
O Lord Jesus You see all things. (3x)
O Lord God open o-ur eyes
Help us to see Jesus Your Son
Who comes to You on our behalf,
Interceding for our needs.

hymns.title: The Work of Prayer
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat World University of Prayer and Fasting. 8th September 2017.

lines: (Exodus 3: 7-9)
When the children of Israel cried unto the Lord,
They cried for help out of misery,
400 and thirty years, Israel's cry reached God,
Then after all of these years God moved.
Those who pray, they need to know the work of prayer,
Those who pray they need to know this truth,
That the Lord, H-e uses all of their prayers
A-nd then, He intervenes on earth.
When we pray God uses these prayers of the saints,
To search for a-nd to raise all the men,
Who will then ca-rry out, a-ll of the work?
Th-at has already been prayed for.
Th-e Lord works in nature by cer-tain laws,
Like the laws th-at we see in farming,
Clear the soil, then we labour and we sow the seed
Then the Lord goes on to send the rain.
The work o-f prayer h-as principles,
The work of prayer ha-s laws,
As the farmer who sows seed, understands his work
Those who pray, must understand their own.
Those who pray must understand how prayer is done
In an intelligent way, it is work,
Th-e work o-f prayer has a strict order,
That is why, w-e must persevere.
Th-e work o-f prayer i-s ha-rd work,
It needs eight hours a day minimum,
You get ready, you prepare and you leave your home,
How you pray from Monday to Friday.
The prayers of all the saints are offered to God
They fill up cups of the Lord in Heaven,
A-nd there co-mes the day when the cup is full
On the earth, th-e angels, they move.
To stop praying when we haven't the answer,
Is such a stupid thing t-o do,
It just shows th-at we un-der-stand no-thing,
About what the work of prayer is.
Those who pray can truly know real peace of God,
Those who pray, they are always at rest,
There is something about them that draws us to God,
They carry Go-d's presence with them.

hymns.title: The Lord Rewards Prayer
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat WUPF for the brethren of Dimako Centre. 7th September 2017.

lines: (Matthew 6: 5-6)
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer
That comes to Him from His children.
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer
Beyond the answ-ers we seek for.
The one who prays, encounters God,
The one who prays, He grows in God,
The one who prays, possesses God,
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer.
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer
He fills His children up with joy.
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer
He gives His children real riches.
The fear of God, the love of God,
A sen-si-tive, o-be-dient heart,
A heart that lives in contentment,
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer.
Those who pray to the Father
Are delivered from all worries.
And those who come to God in prayer
Are made over-com-ers in life.
They are delivered from all sin,
They're joyful and they're reassured,
The peace of God just fills their hearts,
The Lord rewards the ones who pray.
Yes, one reward for those who pray
Is that the Lord gives Himself to them!
To those who will approach the Lord
He comes Himself to transform them.
For those who go to His presence,
They receive something of the Lord,
Even when matters do not change,
They leave God's presence better men.
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer
All those who pray God sanctifies.
The Lo-rd, He rewards prayer
He fills them up with His Spirit.
They seek the Lord, they find the Lord,
They love the Lord, they serve the Lord,
They have anointing for all things,
The Lord rewards the ones who pray.
When you pray to God your Father
He wants you to be true to Him.
Pray to Him in a secret place
He sees and He will reward you.
Put your mobile phone aside,
For fear that you despise the Lord,
Just concentrate, forget the world,
And the Lord, He will reward you.
And when you pray, don't imitate
The hypocrites who like to pray.
While standing on the street corners
Or sy-na-gogues to be seen by men.
Listen to me, my dear children,
For verily, I say to you,
These ones have already received,
Their own reward in its fullness.
If we knew all of the rewards
The Lord has for all those who pray.
Before we entered His service
We would just all be overwhelmed.
The leaders and all of the saints,
Must pray and pray unceasingly,
So, in the end what will be theirs,
Are the rewards that the Lord gives!

hymns.title: Preparation for Service: David's Example-1
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat 7th September 2017.

lines: (1 Samuel 16: 11)
David was not so popular
Amongst his family mem-bers
But he was a faithful servant,
He served his father and brothers.
D-a-vid took care of the flock,
H-e ensured that none was lost,
H-e risked his life for them,
Glory b-e to Jesus.
The ser-vant who serves a man
And satisfies the Father.
Will be promoted by the Lord
To serve, hundreds and thousands.
H-e who lives to serve a man,
H-e is called a s-er-vant,
He who ser-ves many men
He is ca-lled a leader.
(Matthew 23: 11)
All godly leaders, says the Lord
They serve the o-nes they're leading,
David was in the eyes of God
The servant o-f three m-en.
D-a-vid served his father first,
Then he ser-ved King Saul,
And became Achish's servant,
Glory b-e to Jesus.
I-n the school of solitude
David learned to play music.
Throughout his life, he trained himself
To pull the sling and to shoot.
Dav-id trained himself this way,
In the know-ledge of the Lord,
He had a he-art after God's
Glory b-e to Jesus.
(1 Samuel 17:37)
As David faced lions and bears
The Lord took n-o-tice of him.
He watched the way in which he served
His father wi-th his whole heart.
I-n the school of shepherding,
Fo-r five years David had been,
And he was recommended,
Glory b-e to Jesus.
The measure of maturity
Is how you sp-end your free time!
What people do in their spare time
Reveals the tru-th about them.
Le-t us do as David did,
Let us make good use of our time,
To give value to our lives,
Glory b-e to Jesus.
(Numbers 6: 25-26)
David earned two diplomas
The Lord's divine approval.
Then attestation before men
Based upon his merit.
H-e was only seventeen,
Already a good musician,
A brave warrior, a good speaker,
Glory b-e to Jesus.
Oh, may we feel the emptiness
That's found in all of our lives.
And desire to serve the Lord
With o-ur gifts and talents.
Please, Lord open our eyes,
Help us to train ourselves,
And when the time then comes to serve,
We shall all be able.

hymns.title: The Heavens Declare the Glory of God
hymns.author: Translated by World University of Prayer and Fasting. Koume, 4th March 2016.

lines: (Revelation 19: 1-2)
The heavens de-clare the glory of God
The skies proclaim the works of His hands
Day after day, they pour forth their speech
Night after night they make their Cre-a-tor known.
They have no speech, and they use no words
No sound is heard from them, but they speak
Yet their message has gone throughout the earth
And their words have gone to the ends of the world.
For the sun, God pitched a tent in the heavens
It's like a bridegroom coming-out of his chamber
And it rejoices, like a great champion
Eager to run his race with deep assurance.
Oh praise God with the sound of the trumpet
And praise the Lord with the lute and the harp
Praise Him with timbrel and with dancing
Oh, praise the Lord for His excellent greatness.
With stringed instruments, praise the Lord
With clashing cymbals, praise the Lord!
Kings of the whole earth and all the nations
Oh, praise the Lord for He's great and is mighty.

hymns.title: The Word of God
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat World University of Prayer and Fasting. 27th February 2016. (Tune: « Something more than gold. »)

lines: Something more than gold (2x)
The Word of God in the heart of man (2x)
Is something more than gold.
The Word of God is perfect,
The Word of God enlightens,
The Word of God in the heart of man,
Is something more than gold.
The Word revives the soul,
It makes the simple wise,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The Word of God is living,
The Word of God gives new strength,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The Word of God is pure,
It is swee-ter than honey,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The commands of God are clear,
Giving insight for our living,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The Word fills the heart with joy,
The Word of God is radiant,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The fear of the Lord is pure,
It will continue forever,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The Word of God is true,
It is swee-ter than honey,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
The Word of God is a treasure,
Its worth is more than gold,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
From the Word we get instruction,
A reward if we obey it,
The Word of God in the heart of man
Is something more than gold.
O my Lord, I come to You,
That my heart may be softened,
That the word of God received in my heart
Makes me pleasing to God.
Pleasing to the Lord (2)
The Word of God in the heart of man (2x)
Makes pleasing to God!

hymns.title: CMFI
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat 7th September 2017. (Tune: « Dis-moi quel est le but de ta vie. »)

lines: Tell me who we are, CMFI?
What does this name really mean?
Do you know what CMFI is?
Why do we give it this name?
We must all, (2x)
Live out all the aspects of CMFI
For the Lord, (2x)
Didn't give them to us in vain.
F: We serve the Lord in fellowship
And we have a common goal.
We are all agreed to bear on us
The in-te-rests of Jesus
We must all, (2x)
Get involved in the work of our brethren
We must all, (2x)
That their success is o-urs too.
M: We are all to be missionaries
Of the mission of Jesus.
Just as God the Father sent His Son
He has sent us to the world.
We must all, (2x)
Carry the work of our brethren on our heart
We all know, (2x)
That their failure is ours too.
C: Oh yes, we are all chris-ti-ans
Dis-ci-ples of Jesus,
Disciple were called for the first time
Chris-ti-ans in An-ti-och.
We have to, (2x)
Give the Lord one billion disciples
By rend-ering, (2x)
o-be-dience to Him in all things.
I: Yes, we are in-ter-na-tio-nal
Carry-ing nations on our hearts.
We must present to the Lord Jesus
Two hundred and fifty nations.
We must all, (2x)
Represent the Lord where're we go
We all know, (2x)
Is the one we must imitate.
Every church that calls itself a part
Of this work C-M-F-I.
Must invest all of its resources
To accomplish o-ur goal.
We must all, (2x)
Give our prayers, fasting and our people
To nations, (2x)
We must work till they all know Jesus.
We must all, (2x)
Give our prayers, fasting and our money
To nations, (2x)
Working till they all obey Christ.
We must all, (2x)
Live out the aspect of this name we have
For all these things, yes, all these things
Are what make us CMFI.

hymns.title: Being Useful to God
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. WUPF, Koume, 13th September 2017. (Tune: « It only takes a spark. »)

lines: (2 Timothy 2: 20)
Paul said to Timothy
What we have in a big house,
Is not just limited
To silver and gold vessels.
You also find those made of wood
And earthen vessels too,
Some are there for noble use
And some ignoble use.
(2 Timothy 2: 21)
If anyone will cleanse
Himself for all that's sinful,
Flee that which is impure
He'll be a worthy vessel.
An instrument that's made holy
Useful to the Father,
A pure vessel, perfectly clean
And pleasing to the Lord.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
And Paul told him to flee
From every youthful passion,
And pursue righteousness
With peace and faith and lo-ve.
Along with those who call on God
With he-arts that are pure,
You need to keep good company,
With those who fear the Lord.
(2 Timothy 2: 20)
The church can also be
Likened to this large hou-se,
And all its articles
They represent the members.
The church is the house of the Lord
And God is its owner,
And we are just the ve-ss-els,
That God will use to work.
(2 Timothy 2: 20)
Oh yes, each one of us
Are vessels in this large house,
But the Lord uses us
Di-fferent-ly from each other.
He has called some to approach Him
Be close to Him in prayer,
Others are called to spread His Word,
The good news to sinners.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
Paul said to Timothy
That every man and woman,
Who takes away all dirt,
From his heart and pro-t-ects;
From playing when it's time to work,
Stealing, fighting, lying,
From being stingy or selfish,
The Lord can use this one.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
Eh son: always s-ay: "No!"
To every form of falsehood,
To your many secrets,
Things that you say to no one,
Re-bel-lion and independence,
To-wards your pa-re-nts,
And in five years or in ten years,
You'll be useful to God.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
Just go on to remove
All of these evil thi-ngs,
And the Lord will use you
For His noble purposes.
Pray, be faithful to teach the Word,
Go as miss-ion-a-ry,
Go help the poor and heal the sick,
The Lord God will use you.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
Timothy believed God
And he grew very quickly,
For his mother Eunice,
She taught her son the Bible.
Timothy kn-ew the Scriptures,
He memorised them too,
In doing this, he then prepared,
To be useful to God.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
From Timothy's childhood
He did study the Bible,
And therefore, he acquired
A vast amount of knowledge.
Even at the age of 16
He w-as a teacher,
In 3 churches, he taught elders,
He was useful to God.
(2 Timothy 2: 22)
Timothy believed God
Like his mother and grandma,
He la-id on their faith,
Believed God in the same way.
Have you believed in Jesus Christ?
Like your mum or your dad,
Don't remain an unbeliever,
God has no grand-children.
All children, they must stop
Believing that it's adults
Who mu-st love the Lord!
And give to Him their worship.
I want to be useful to God
Just as Timothy was,
Please, help me Lord to be useful,
While I am st-ill young.
I'll serve God, while I'm young. (2x)

hymns.title: Jesus Christ
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting. Koume, 4th July 2015. (Tune: « il est Roi... que toute la terre. »)

lines: He is King, He is King
And He is Lord of Lords,
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice
In His name.
He is King. Jesus Christ is King.
(Revelation 1: 5)
Jesus Christ is the Faithful witness
He is the First born from the death
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice In His name.
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Revelation 1:5)
Jesus Christ is the Faithful witness
Oh yes, He rules the Kings of the earth
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice In His name
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Revelation 1:5)
Yes, Jesus Christ has delivered us
By His blood from all s-in in us
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice In His name
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Revelation 1:6)
Christ has made us to be a kingdom,
Priests to serve His God a-nd Father
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice In His name
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Revelation 1: 5)
Jesus Christ is Alpha, Omega
Jesus Christ is the Almighty
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice In His name
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Matthew 28: 18-20)
In His Name, we proclaim the gospel
In His Name, we impo-se His reign
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice
In His name
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Matthew 28: 18-20)
In His Name, we all make disciples
Of Jesus Christ in every nation,
Let all of the earth rise and rejoice
In His name
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
(Colossians 1: 18)
O-ur goal is to e-nsure that
Men will love the God with all their hearts
That all men may worship and bow Before him
For indeed, Jesus Christ is King.
(Matthew 28: 18-20)
In His name, we go to plant churches
For His kingdom to b-e ordained
All over the world let every knee bow do-wn
Saying that Jesus Christ is King.

hymns.title: Let Us Praise His Name
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF World University of Prayer and Fasting. Koume, 27th February 2016. Revised, 2nd April 2016. (Tune: « Down at the cross where my Saviour died. »)

lines: (Revelation 19: 6)
Hallelujah! let us praise our God,
For o'ur Lord God Almighty reigns.
The sceptre's in His hand! He is king
Let us praise His name.
Let us praise His na-me (2x)
Let us rejoice and be glad in Him,
Giving Him the praise.
(Revelation 19: 7)
Let us rejoice and be glad in Him,
And give Him honour and praise with joy
Bringing our tributes and our trophies
To the Lord who reigns.
(Revelation 19: 7-8)
The wedding feast of the Lamb has come,
His bride is made ready for that day,
Clo-thed with fine linen: bright and pure
Shining, bright and clear.
(Revelation 19: 8-9)
The linens are good deeds of the saints,
Bles-sed are those who'll be at the feast,
They laboured not on this earth in vain
They will feast with Him.
(Revelation 22: 14)
Bles-sed are those who have washed their robes,
That they may eat of the tree of life,
And enter God's city by the gates
So, the Lord has said!
(Revelation 22: 15)
Outside the city are all the dogs,
The se-xua-lly immoral; wizards,
Murderers, idolaters, liars,
And debaucherers.
(Revelation 22: 16)
This message I've sent to the whole Church
Through My angel I have testified,
"I, Jesus, I'm the Bright Morning Star,
Offspring of David."
(Revelation 22: 12)
"I am the Alpha and Omega,
I am the First and I am the Last,
I am the Beginning and the End,
And I'm coming soon!"
(Revelation 22: 17)
The Spirit and the Bride both say "Come"
Let him who hears this word say "oh come"
Let anyone who is thirsty come,
So, the Lord has said.

hymns.title: Christ Is Risen
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat, World University of Prayer and Fasting for Ministers of Prayer. Koume, 10th July 2015. (Tune: « Gloire Il est ressuscité. »)

lines: Glo-ry Jesus is risen,
Ah! He is alive,
we proclaim it this day,
Ah! Hallelujah, praise the Lord
Jesus has overcome death.
(Acts 2: 24)
God, raised Him from the dead, ah!
By delivering Him from the chains of death,
ah! For it was not possible,
For death to with-hold Him.
(1 Corinthians 15: 20)
Christ is risen, this is true, ah!
He is the first fruit of those who were dead,
Ah! Like Him we also shall rise,
When He'll come to take us home.
(1 Corinthians 15: 52)
Death is just like a mere sleep, for,
Those who believe in Jesus Christ the Lord
For, one day they will also rise,
Oh, what a great hope indeed.
(Revelation 1: 18)
Jesus said I am the First, ah!
I am the Last and yes, I am alive, ah!
And I hold the keys of death,
Yes, I hold the keys of hades.
(Revelation 5: 5)
Glo-ry to the risen Christ, ah!
Lion of Judah, the Root of David, ah!
He overcame to open
The scroll and its seven seals.
(Revelation 5: 7-8)
Prai-se the Lamb who was slain,
He went and took the scroll from the right hand
Of, Hi-m who sat on the throne,
Then all bowed before the Lamb.
(Revelation 5: 10)
By Your blood You purchased for God,
People from eve-ry tong-ue and tribe,
ah! People from every language
People from every nation.
(Revelation 5: 10)
You have made them a kingdom, ah!
You've made them priests to serve o-ur God,
ah! Yes, they will reign on the earth,
Living to serve o-ur God.
(Revelation 5: 12-13)
Worthy 's the Lamb that was slain, ah
To receive power and to receive we-
alth, ah! Receive honour and wisdom,
Receive the glory and praise.

hymns.title: God Sees Everything
hymns.author: World University of Prayer and Fasting. Translated by Gabrielle Djiwat For Ministers of Prayer Koume, 10th July 2015.

lines: O Lord, You know when I am low,
You search me, Lord and You know me,
You know when I sit and when I rise,
You perceive my thoughts from afar.
(Psalm 139: 3)
Yes, Lord You know my going out,
You also know when I lay down,
O Lord my God in Your great wisdom,
You get insight of all my ways.
(Psalm 139: 4)
Before a word is on my tongue,
Dear Lord, You know it completely,
Won-der-fu-lly, in-te-lli-gently,
You already know it wholly.
You hem me in the front and back,
And you lay Your hand upon me,
Such a knowledge is so amazing,
And is beyond un-der-stand-ing.
Where can I go from Your Spirit,
Where can I flee from Your presence,
If I go to the heavens, You're there,
Even in the depths, Lord, You're there.
Surely the night will become light,
They are not dark before Your eyes,
For you, O Lord, every-thing is light,
The night will shine to You as day.
Lord You formed me, Lord You knit me,
Together in my mo-ther's womb,
I praise You Lord, for such a creature,
So wonderful, You've made of me.
When I was still just without form,
Your eyes saw my unformed body,
All my days in your book were written,
Before each of them came to be.
How precious are, Your thoughts of me,
More numerous than the grains of sand,
How vast the sum of them, O Father!
So great for me to count ever.

hymns.title: Jesus Christ Is the Son of God
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat World University of Prayer and Fasting Koume, 11th February, 2016.

lines: Jesus Christ is the Son of God
The Saviour of the world
Jesus Christ is the Word of God
And He is Lord.
Every day of my life,
Moving on, step by step,
I'm walking with my Saviour,
He will sustain me.
Jesus Christ died for o-ur sins
At the cross of calvary,
Then, He rose again from the dead,
He lives forever.
Jesus a-scen-ded to hea-ven
Be-fore His disciples,
And He is seated on the throne,
He's the King of kings.
He received from God, His Father
The Ho-ly Spi-rit sent,
Jes-us' Spi-rit is in me,
Jesus has saved me.
He has sent me in-to this world
To my school, my quarter,
To my friends and to my neighbours,
To tell them of Him.
I am a light in-to this world
In my school, my quarter,
To my friends and to my neighbours,
To tell them of Him.
I will wa-lk as Josiah did
I will bring revival,
I will walk as Timothy did
Then, I'll be useful.
He's preparing a place for me
In Heaven, His Father's Home,
He will come back to take me home
To be there with Him.
While I spend my days here on earth
I'll serve Him with all my heart,
I am waiting for His return,
When I'll fly away.
Your divine Presence always sheds
Its rays on my path here below:
Then with a cheerful heart I'll walk
Without a fear for the next day.
Where e'r You lead, I'll follow You.
O blessed Lamb just guide my steps.
A second without Your Presence
Is not for me! For that's not life!
Oh, may I know a cloudless walk
With my Beloved! My Bless-ed King,
And when the storms are raging high
Keep my eyes fixed on Thee, my Star.
To sit for ever at Your feet,
This be my happy choice each day!
My only care, delight and bliss!
My joy, my heav'n on earth be this.

hymns.title: Fasting Intercession for Cameroon
hymns.author: Translated by Helen Ngankwe Koume, 30th July 2010. Revised, 2nd April 2016. (Tune: « Would you be free from your burden of sin »)

lines: Would you like to see Cameroon prosper?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Would you like to co-operate with the Lord?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Oh, be a fasting intercessor,
And so, bless your nation
For the purpose of the Almighty,
For Cameroon to be accomplished.
Would you like your nation to be Exalted?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Would you like poverty to be expelled?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Do you want it a nation of abundance?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Yes, the Lord's abundance in every sense?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Do you want it to be full of God's blessings?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Do you want it to be a great nation?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Do you want Cameroon to live in peace?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Do you want what God has done to abide?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Do you want to see our Lord Jesus revealed?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Do you want to see His gospel prosper?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Do you want to see multitudes find Jesus?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Do you want to see whole villages saved?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
Do you want to see the saints by Him raised?
Fast on Wednesdays (2x)
Unto posts of responsibility?
Fast and pray every Wednesday.
The satanic prince of Ca-me-roon
Had been bound and overthrown,
On the sev-eventh of June 2002
For ever he's been overthrown.
Jesus is on the throne of this nation
Of Cameroon (2x)
Oh yes, we shall soon see His hand at work,
So as to manifest His love.

hymns.title: The Possibilities of Prayer
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting General Course. Koume, 13th December 2016.

lines: (Ephesians 3: 20)
To Him who by the mighty power
That work-eth in our lives,
Be glo-ry and all honour.
To Him be glory in the church
And unto Jesus Christ.
To Him who does im-mea-su-ra-bly
More than we all can ask,
And even what we may think.
Our Lord and God is able to give us
Everything that we ask,
If only we ask of Him.
We cannot ever ask Him too much
We only have to dare,
And God will grant our requests.
Bring to the Lord all of your requests
No matter how heavy,
His reserves are infinite.
No go-vern-ment can give a man
This kind of guarantee
For they are all lim-it-ed.
What is accomplished when we ask
Is more than when we work,
That is why we have to pray.
Oh pray, oh pray, we have to pray
Prayer, is the true work.
Oh prayer, yes, it is Our way
To get su-pre-ma-cy
To make o-ur Lord God known.
By prayer we obtain from God
His all and mighty power,
To make known the Lord's glory.
Let's pray, let's pray without ceasing
For prayer is true work.
The fastest way we have my brothers
To get to great treasure,
Oh brethren, is by prayer.
Praying, praying without ceasing
Praying, this is true work.
How can we allow o-ur burdens
In prayer be selfish,
When o-ur God is so great?
(Psalm 147: 9)
In this world are many glories
that dazzle people's minds,
Med-i-cine and even science
Also, tech-no-lo-gy;
God wants us to make known His glory
To all through prayer,
And that's why we have to pray.
The church, the church of Jesus Christ
Displays the Lord's glory
The church, the church of Jesus Christ
Makes known the Lord's glory.
O Lord Jesus reveal to us
What prayer really is,
So that we all can pray.
The church, the church of Jesus Christ
Displays the Lord's glory

hymns.title: Jabez
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat, WUPF, General Course.

lines: (1 Chronicles 4: 9)
Jabez was set apart
From his brothers,
What made him be apart
I-t was prayer.
The others had remarked,
That he was set apart
As a result of prayer,
He was not the same.
(1 Chronicles 4: 9)
But there was something wrong
With Jabez's name,
It was a pro-phe-cy
That he did not like.
The name Jabez means "Pain,"
This name revolted him,
Jabez then cried to God,
And God changed his life.
(1 Chronicles 4:9)
Men can be classified
In different ranks,
There are those from your tribe,
Or from your clan.
There are men and women,
But among all the men,
The man of prayer is,
Not a normal man.
(1 Chronicles 4:9)
The names we bear on us
Mean something deep,
They are like pro-ph-cies
That follow us.
Do you know what follows?
You in the name you have,
It's like a signature,
On o-ur lives.
(1 Chronicles 4: 9)
Have you a dreadful name
Like Jabez had.
Do you know the meanings?
Of all your names?
Is it, lamentation?
Death or even curses?
Remove these names from you,
Please take a stand.
(1 Chronicles 4: 9)
Jabez cried out to God
O Lord, my God;
Please take away this curse,
Bless me indeed,
Jabez cried out to God,
Expand my territory,
Keep me O God from harm,
And from all pain.
(1 Chronicles 4:9)
Jabez knew very well
What he wanted,
And you my friend, do you
Know what you want?
Jabez ex-pe-ri-enced
The po-ssi-bi-li-ties,
Of what pray-er can do,
in someone's life.
(1 Chronicles 4:9)
Friend, fill your life with God
And you will flow,
Pray without complaining
A-bout your trials.
May God enable us,
To per-se-vere in prayer,
May we be like Jabez,
Vic-to-ri-ous.

hymns.title: I Want to Be Like Abraham
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat 7th Crusade of Prayer and Fasting. Koume, 8th November 2015.

lines: (Genesis 12: 1-3)
The Lord God said to Abraham,
Rise from here, leave this place,
Go away from your father's home,
To where I'll show you.
All those who will bless you,
I will bless them in return
All people of the earth
Will be blessed through you.
(Hebrews 11: 8-9)
It is by faith that Abraham
Obeyed and went away,
To settle in a foreign land,
Pro-mised by the Lord.
Abraham lived in tents,
As did Isaac and Jacob
Who had in-herited,
Of the same promise.
(Hebrews 11: 11)
Yes, t'was by faith that Sarah
Who was past child-bearing age,
Was enabled to bear children,
A poste-ri-ty.
Because she had believed
In the faithfulness of God
She became, a mother,
Mother of nations.
(Genesis 17: 6)
I want to be like Abraham
Father of kings, of nations,
I will produce mission-aries,
Very great leaders.
All my life all my life
I will live to please my God
All my life, all my life
I will be fruitful
(Genesis 17: 6)
Yes, I want to be like Sarah
Mother of kings, of nations
I will produce mission-aries
Very great leaders.
(Genesis 90: 17)
Very soon there will be elders
And very great givers
Great servants and great princes too
Found all around me.
(Matthew 28: 18-20)
Lord, I plead anoint me this day
To be ve-ry distinct
To go make disciples for You
People You will use.

hymns.title: The Blood of Jesus
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. (Tune: « Le nom de Jésus est si doux. »)

lines: (Hebrews 10: 19)
Oh, my dear brethren we all have
A way to God by Jesus' blood,
Free entry to His holy place
To the ho-ly of ho-lies.
(Hebrews 10: 20)
By the new and the living way
That Christ by His body has made
The way has been opened to us
Let's enter the holy place.
The precious blood of Jesus,
Opens our way un-to God.
Free entry to Him at all times
The blood of Christ has power
(Hebrews 10: 22)
So, by the blood of Jesus Christ
Brethren, let's draw close to the Lord,
With a sincere and open heart
Be-ing washed with pure water.
(Exodus 12: 13)
The Lord had said that when I see
The blood over you, I will pass,
No judgement will come upon you
The blood of Christ has power.
(Hebrews 10: 17)
The blood of Christ is the red light
of God that calms Him from His wrath,
My judgement, it will bypass you
The blood of Christ has power.
(Hebrews 10: 17)
The blood can work in a conscience
Dealing with all a-ccu-sa-tions,
It brings all voices to silence
The blood of Christ has power.
(Hebrews 10: 17)
The blood also works against sin
Against all blame, against all guilt,
It takes away the dirt of sin
The blood of Christ has power.
Yes, there is not blessed water
That can purify the heart,
Like Jesus' blood that cleanses hearts
The blood of Christ has power.
(Hebrews 10: 17)
The blood is the lone detergent
The blood is the lone dissolvent,
The blood even works morally
The blood of Christ has power.
(Hebrews 10: 17)
The blood can work on demons too
And it deprives them of their rights,
It takes away all claims they have
The blood of Christ has power.
All that renders powerless
The devil and his demons,
Is powerful such is His blood
The blood of Christ has power.

hymns.title: The Ministry to Children
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting, For Ministers to Children. Koume, 11th February 2017.

lines: You all mi-ni-sters to children,
It's time to gi-ve your li-fe.
Yes, the mi-nis-ters to children,
Do all to impart li-fe.
I-t is life that comes from God,
I-t is life received from God,
Life received in His presence,
Given t-o the children.
All the mi-nis-ters to children,
Must give their ch-il-dren li-fe.
All the mi-nis-ters to children,
Must give their child-ren li-fe.
Th-e minister to children,
Th-ey must give the life of God,
They must enter God's fullness,
They must be filled with God's life.
Who's a mi-nis-ter to children.
A person wh-o gives li-fe.
To children who are dead in sin,
These children Go-d's given them.
Th-e minister to children,
Th-ey must have the life of God.
They must all be full of God.
They must be filled with God's life.
The Word of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Brings people ba-ck to li-fe.
Elijah by touching the boy,
He brought him ba-ck to li-fe.
Th-e minister to children,
Th-ey must have the life of God,
They must all be full of God,
And give the children God's life.
All the mi-nis-ters to children,
They must be ri-ch with Go-d.
They must be rich spi-ri-tua-lly,
Such that they bl-ess the children.
Th-e minister to children,
Th-ey must have the life of God,
They must all be full of God,
And give the children God's life.
Oh yes, mi-nis-ters to children,
Must be blessings to the children,
They must bless them and give to them,
The riches they have acquired.
Th-e minister to children.
Th-ey must have the life of God,
They must all be full of God
And give the children God's life.

hymns.title: An Isaac Year Upon CMFI
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald, 31st of August 2017.

lines: Oh, how wonderful the Word, O Lord
You have given us,
You have pronounced up-on C-M-F-I
An Isaac year;
For all in-di-vi-duals, chur-ches and Mi-ssio-na-ries too,
The en-ti-re work You've given us
All over the world.
In your so-wing, your rea-ping
All domains of your lives,
Your blessings, one-hundred-fold
As God blessed Isaac.
Oh yes, children I will sur-prise you
With massive results,
Children, I will surprise you
With great blessings all around;
And I heal you all from failure
My children this day,
Yes, I bless you and I give you
An Isaac year everywhere.
I will make your sons strong, oh yes,
I give you the po-wer,
Yes, to enter and to triumph
In new te-rri-to-ries,
In new cultures and new lan-gua-ges,
And in new nations,
And you shall spread
To the ends of Pla-net Earth.
It is a year of results
And of My favour
It is a year of results
Unexplainable.
You will no longer withdraw
From a-n-y obstacles
I will bless you, bless you, bless you,
And I will bless you more,
You will prosper, you will prosper
Yes, I will prosper you,
And you'll see the mighty hand
Of God at work u-pon You.
You will no longer withdraw
From a-n-y obstacles
You will go and you'll possess
The gates of your enemies
O my children, sow and sow and sow
And I will bless you
O my dear children receive from
M-e an Isaac year.

hymns.title: It Is Good to Praise You Lord

lines: It is good to praise You Lord
Proclaim Your love in the morning
To make music to Your name
And proclaim Your faith-ful-ness.
It is wonderful to lift You high
At the break of day
Father Lord, You are my shelter
In you I find refuge.
You are my King, my best Friend
Lover of my soul
You are the Lord, and the Rock
Of my salvation.
(Numbers 23: 19).
O Your Word, Lord is the truth
And it always comes to pass
You are not a man,
Nor a son of man for You to lie.
All the words that come from Your
mouth Your Hand a-ccom-pli-shes
All Your promises are sure
Yes, they always come to pass.
(Psalm 91)
O Lord, I've seen Your protection
And in You I am safe
I've no worries for the future
For my life is in You.
You have raised Your mighty Hand
Against all dan-ger and harm
You have placed Your hand upon me
Who can stand against You.

hymns.title: A Lover for a Saviour
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald. 2nd September 2017.

lines: What a great story, a great story,
Man to leave the world,
And follow Christ;
And to make a friend,
With the Lord Jesus;
What a great story, great story.
What a great story, a great story,
To have as Saviour,
And a lover,
Who has loved us and,
Given us His all;
What a great story, great story.
What a great story, a great story,
To be in-vi-ted,
To love the Lord;
To be in-vi-ted,
To behold the Lord;
What a great story, great story.
What a great story, a great story,
To be in-vi-ted,
To give ourselves,
Our time, our money,
And o-ur all;
All to serve the Lord, o-ur God.
What a great story, a great story,
To be ministers
Of prayer
Called upon by the
government of Heaven,
What a great story, great story.
If we had to fight for worldly rank,
Who among us would,
Be mi-ni-sters?
Bu-t in His love,
God has chosen us,
And has made us His mi-nis-ters.
Our God and Father
By choosing us,
Has assigned to us a distinct call,
And each one of us,
Has to pay the price,
To accomplish His pur-po-ses.
O Lord, transform all o-ur ministry,
To be saints for You,
Con-se-cra-ted,
To be disciples
Of the Lord Jesus,
Please do it, O Lord, for them all.
O Lord help each of the mi-nis-ters,
To deepen their walk,
Their walk with God,
And to help all those,
Who are under them,
To grow in their walk with the Lord.
Oh, we thank You Lord,
For this great call,
To belong to You, and to serve You,
For the pri-vi-ledge,
To be Your lo-vers
What a glor-ious future ahead.
One must water,
One must weed,
To tend the garden of love.
You take a little seed,
One must sow the precious seed.
We all work in unity,
And put it in the ground.
You spread a little love,
And cheer around.
plant a little kindness from above,
And you have the garden of love.

hymns.title: Vanity, All Is Vanity
hymns.author: Koume, 27th February 2016. Revised, 2nd April 2016.

lines: (Matthew 16: 26. Ecclesiastes 1: 2. Mark 8:36)
Vanity! All is vanity.
What will it profit a man?
If he gains the world
And loses his soul.
Oh, if one could give to you,
All the riches of this world.
Oh, if one could give to you,
All the houses and the cars.
When you will be down in your grave
Where will all the riches be?
When you will be in the graveyard
Where will all your houses be?
Oh, if one could offer you,
The beauty queens of this world.
Oh, if one could give to you,
The handsome men of this earth.
Then when you will be in the grave
Where will all those women be?
When you will be in the graveyard
Where will be the handsome men?
If one were to give you,
All diplomas of this world.
Oh, if one could give to you,
The promotions you desire.
When you will be in the coffin,
Where will these diplomas be?
When you will be in the graveyard,
Where will your promotions be?
Oh, if you come to Jesus Christ
He'll forgive you all your sins,
Oh, if you come to Him today,
He will save you from all sin,
And when your time comes to d-ie,
You will go to be with God.
And then when that day will co-me,
He'aven will open for you.
Jesus Christ is the only way!
Jesus Christ, the way to Heaven and God
Jesus Christ, He's the one Saviour
Jesus Christ, the Saviour of the world.
If you come to Jesus now,
He will give you tr-ue life.
Oh, if you come to Jesus Christ,
He will give you H-is peace,
And while you are here on this earth,
He will walk along with you.
And while you are here on this earth,
He will be your faithful friend.
It is good to be God's child,
But that is not the end.
Good to have God's life in you,
But the Lord has more to give.
You must invest all of your life,
To accomplish God's designs.
You must get yourself involved,
In world conquest for the Lord.
Have a goal!
For your life with God
Have a goal!
To serve your God and King.
Oh, it is not just enough,
To flee from the lake of fire.
Oh, it is not just enough,
To have entry to heaven.
You must use your life on earth,
To spread God's kingdom on earth.
You must use your life on ea-rth,
To impose His reign on earth.
Friend, to wake up every day,
With no goal for your life.
When some people make a goal,
It is for the things of earth.
How to go and look for money,
How to go and look for food.
Or to gather much wealth on earth,
Just to leave these when they die.
Vanity! All is vanity.
What a was-te of a life
To live on earth
Without a goal.
Give yourself to serve your God,
To bring the lost souls to Him.
Give yourself to serve your God,
T-o win the world for Him.
Then your life will have some value,
Both in time'n eternity.
Then your life will not be wasted
Both in time! 'n eternity.

hymns.title: The Books of the New Testament
hymns.author: Unknown Author.

lines: The first four books which come along
Are: Matthew, Mark, and Luke and John.
Then come Acts and Romans too,
Yes, the first six books are easy to see.
First and second Corin-thi-ans,
Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians.
Now remember Colos-sians next in line
With the two Thessaloni-ans right behind
First and second Timothy,
The other half way is easy to see.
Titus, Philemon, Hebrews and James.
Now, only seven more remain.
We have first and second Peter,
And then first John.
But John has three books,
Before we go on.
Now we're almost gone,
There's only Jude.
And Revelation,
Now our song is through.

hymns.title: Let's Give Thanks
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF. Koume, 4th March 2016. Revised 2nd April 2016. (Tune: « Glory be to God the Father. »)

lines: Let's give thanks to God the Father.
Let's give thanks to God the Son.
Let's give thanks to God the Spirit.
Come to Him with grateful hearts,
Let us give thanks, let's give thanks,
To God who's so good to us.
It is good to bring thanksgivings.
To exalt th' Eternal One.
God exhorts us: Always give thanks!
To the Lord for all He does,
Let us give thanks, let's give thanks.
To our God for all His love.
God desires that we should thank Him.
Expressing our gratitude,
We should therefore always give thanks.
To the Lord for His goodness.
Let us give thanks, let's give thanks.
Let's give thanks to o-ur God.
When you pray and God answers you,
Come back and say: "Thank You Lord"
In His goodness and His bounty
He gives what we ne'er asked for,
Tell Him: "Thank You." Tell Him: "Thank You."
For His goodness and mercy.
One of the dangers in leading
As we grow in leadership.
One begins to take for granted,
What the younger ones give us.
Let us judge this ingratitude,
We must rather say: "Thank You."
If your eyes see nothing but
The negative things in your wife,
More than you can see the good things,
Know then that you're ungrateful.
Brother give thanks, brother give thanks
For all that is good in her.
And if you see more things that are
Negative in your husband,
More than you can see the good things,
This shows you are ungrateful.
Sister, give thanks. Sister give thanks,
For all that is good in him.
All the women who're ungrateful,
Never, never say: "Thank you."
But the women who are humble
Say, "Thank You" to their husbands.
Oh wives, give thanks. Oh wives, give thanks,
For your husbands, please give thanks.
All the men who are ungrateful,
Never, never say: "Thank you."
But those who are of humble hearts,
Say, "Thank You" to the-ir wives.
Men, say: "Thank you" Men, say: "Thank you."
Men, say: "Thank you" for your wives.
Those who do not learn to give thanks,
Will be always covetous.
They will grumble, they will complain,
Of what God does in their lives.
And instead of saying: "Thank You"
They are full of jealousy.
Jesus gave thanks to the Father,
For all things and at all times.
Jesus Christ is o-ur model.
Let us show our gratitude.
Let us give thanks, let us give thanks,
To God just as Jesus did.
Paul th'apostle always gave thanks
For the saints when'er he prayed.
We should also always give thanks,
For this is the will of God.
Let us give thanks, let us give thanks,
To the Lord for His goodness.
From early in the morning,
Till late at night,
All that I need is You.
My only hope is You, Jesus,
My only hope is You.
From early in the morning,
Till late at night,
My only hope is You.
My only peace is You, Jesus,
My only peace is You.
From early in the morning,
Till late at night,
My only peace is You.
My only joy is You, Jesus,
My only joy is You.
From early in the morning,
Till late at night,
My only joy is You.
All that I need is You, Jesus,
All that I need is You.
From early in the morning,
Till late at night,
All that I need is You.

hymns.title: Come, Let Us Sing Unto the Lord
hymns.author: Revised, 2nd April 2016. (Tune: « He leadeth me. »)

lines: (Psalm 95: 1)
Come, let us sing unto the Lord,
With loud acclamations to God.
Let's shout with joy and praise His name,
He is the Rock, our Salvation.
Oh come, let's sing unto the Lord,
Let's praise Him who's our Lord and God.
Let's shout with joy and praise His name,
He is the Rock, Our Salvation.
(Psalm 95: 2)
With thanksgiving let's come to Him
Extol Him with music and song
With hymns of praise and psalms of praise
And dance with joy to praise His name.
(Psalm 95: 3)
For God our Lord is the great God,
And the great King above all gods.
His throne's established from of old,
He reigns! He is the one true God
(Psalm 95: 4)
The deep places of all the earth,
The Lord holds in His mighty hand.
The heavens too, the Lord has made!
Let's praise His name and worship Him.
(Psalm 95: 5)
The mountain peaks belong to Him,
The sea is His, for He made it.
The dry land too His hand did form,
To the Creator homage bring.
(Psalm 95: 6)
Come! Let us bow down in worship,
Let's kneel before Him who made us.
Let's lie down prostrate at His feet.
Before the God ou-r Creator!
(Psalm 95: 7)
The Lord made us and we are His,
We are of God's own workmanship.
He is our God! and we His sheep.
The flock He pastors, and He feeds.

hymns.title: Jesus Wants Me for a Sunbeam

lines: Jesus wants me for a sunbeam
To shine for Him each day:
In every way try to please Him,
At home, at school, at play.
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
Jesus wants me for a sunbeam,
A sunbeam, a sunbeam,
I'll be a sunbeam for Him.
Jesus wants me to be loving,
And kind to all I see,
Showing how pleasant and holy,
His little one can be.
I will ask Jesus to help me,
To keep my heart from sin,
Ever reflecting His goodness,
And always shine for Him.
I'll be a sunbeam for Jesus
I ask Him for His grace
Serving Him moment by moment
Then, live with Him on high.
Jesus will make me His sunbeam
I count on Him alone
Minute by minute, He leads me
To always shine for Him.

hymns.title: In His Name (The Name of Jesus)
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF Team. 9th Crusade of Praise and Thanksgiving. Koume, 3rd January 2018. (Tune: « Alléluia, gloire à Dieu, Il m'a créé à Son image »)

lines: Hallelujah, praise the Lord!
I've received the Lord Jesus Christ,
And now I am a child of God,
Hallelujah, hallelujah!
(John 1: 12)
To all who received the Lord (Jesus)
Those who believed in His na-me
Jesus gives them the pow'r to become
Children of God! And so, they are!
(Acts 2: 38)
The Holy Ghost is received,
By faith in the Name of Jesus.
Pow'r comes and healing is received
In that same Name! Name of Jesus.
(Philippians 2: 9-11)
Hallelujah, praise the Lord!
Jesus received that precious name
Which He gave to His Church on earth
For life in Him and His service.
(1 Corinthians 6: 11)
We have been washed! Purified!
Sanctified and jus-ti-fi-ed,
In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
And the Spirit of o-ur God.
(Ephesians 5: 18-21)
To our Father, God, give thanks,
At each moment for everything
In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
We'll be courteous to one and all.
(Colossians 3: 17)
Brethren! Whatever you do,
Whether in word! Whether in deeds,
Do it all in the name of Jesus Christ,
Giving thanks to God the Father.
(Hebrews 13: 15)
Sacrifice of praise we'll bring.
Night and day to God our Father,
From our lips that confess Jesus' name
To o-ur God, glory we'll bring.
"In the name of Jesus Christ"
Not just an ending of our prayers,
We must live in the name of Jesus Christ
Then we can pray in His name too.
Since we've believed in Jesus
We must love all of our brethren,
That is what You have ordered us, O Lord,
We will obey You, O-ur God.

hymns.title: Thank You Lord
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald. Prophecy of 9th Crusade of Praise and Thanksgiving. Koume, 13th October 2017. (Tune: « Comment te dire ô tendre Père merci. »)

lines: How can we give You thanks,
Gracious Father?
Thank You, thank You
For Your Word, O Lord
And Your promi-ses
Oh, thank You.
Thank You Lord, thank You Lord,
We thank You, O Lord, thank You Lord.
You have proclaimed it,
You have declared it,
Thank you, thank You
That all your children,
Who Glorify You,
Praise Your name.
Those who prepare their hearts,
They will witness
God's salva-tion,
Those who prepare their hearts
Will witness
God's salva-tion.
You've spoken, You've spoken,
You've spoken, O Lord It's Your Word.
What you have started,
Is something novel,
Thus, says the Lord.
Something new and re-vo-lu-tion-ary,
Says the Lord.
This season of praise
And of thanksgiving,
Thus, says the Lord,
Will bring about some great transformations
For leaders.
You will turn Your heart
And turn Your eyes Lord,
Thank you, thank you.
On all your children of CMFI,
O thank You.
You'll multiply
the Garoua o-be-dience
By one-hundred.
You'll multiply the Garoua experience
Hundred-fold.
Many among us
We will experience.
Thank You, thank you.
Extra'dinary encounters with God
Oh, thank You.
Your eyes, Your hand Lord
O Lord, Your presence
Thank you, thank You.
Will fall on men, fa-mi-lies and churches
Oh, thank you.
And the en-ti-re
Community Lord
Thank you, thank you.
We will all ex-per-ience
Your great power,
Oh, thank you.
A ministry of
People who seek God
Thank you, thank you.
Will be transformed
To people who find God,
Oh, thank you.
During the fast,
While we are together,
Thank you, thank you,
You shall come to us and appear to us,
Oh, thank you.
Your presence, Your glory
and Your Spirit,
Thank you, thank you
Will come on us in a tangible way,
Oh, thank you.
There will be so many revelations,
Thank you, thank you.
There'll be dreams,
Trances and many visions,
Oh, thank You.
You will manifest
Yourself to many,
Thank you, thank You.
As in-di-vi-duals
Also, as churches,
Oh, thank You.
You will con-ti-nue
to visit us Lord,
Thank you, thank You.
And o-ur work,
You've said "will be easy"
Oh, thank You.
This is the day, Lord,
Of Your great power,
Thank You, thank You.
Your ma-ni-fes-ta-tions
multiplied Lord,
Oh, thank You.
Lord, you will send us
So many wa-ves,
Thank you, thank You.
Waves of Your presence,
Waves of Your power
Oh, thank you.

hymns.title: Pray Together
hymns.author: Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh. WUPF General Course. Koume, 25th December 2017. (Tune: « Pray on, pray on, the Lord commands. »)

lines: Together pray, together pray,
All you who have the same mission.
Together pray, together pray,
So as to have the same vision.
Husband and wife together pray,
All in the household meet and pray.
Pray with disciples, those you lead,
And as a church-we need to pray.
(Acts 1: 14)
Together pray, together pray,
To have oneness of mind and heart.
Together pray, together pray,
The Lord will co-me your spirits blend.
All who desire to serve as one,
With women, children, meet and pray,
Together constantly in pray'r,
Will stir your hea-rts to pray and work.
Together pray, together pray,
Be willing the-n to pay the price.
Together pray, together pray,
Walk in the li-ght with each other.
Transparency, it is a must,
For fellowship, we must be true,
We need to pray, together pray,
If we must work, together work.
Together pray, together pray,
We must be o-f one heart, one mind.
Together pray, together pray,
Each one must speak and live the truth.
As co-workers, we need to pray,
Agree in whatever we ask,
We need the truth, we need the light,
Hiding, pretending will block our pray'r.
Together pray, together pray,
With young converts and disciples,
With patience and humility,
Till you begin to see as one.
When missionaries pray as one,
They will become welded at heart,
It's not a choice to meet and pray,
But a weapon, we must exploit.
Together pray, together pray,
Assemble wi-th all who believe.
The first four months just meet and pray,
And let them share their testimony.
The sacrament of family,
Together eat, together pray,
For when we share a meal as one,
It helps to bui-ld relationships.
When brethren meet and share a meal,
Each one is he-lped to feel at home.
Open their hearts and freely speak,
And so, we ge-t to know them more.
We know their lives; we know their past,
Their gifts and talents, challenges,
And so, relationships are strong,
In fellowshi-p around a meal.
When leaders of a local church,
Gather regu-larly to pray.
The Lord will come and dwell with them,
They will be welded in harmony.
The church in Antioch Acts Thirteen,
Her leaders were prophets, teachers,
They knew the Lord, they knew His word,
They valued wha-t each one could bring.
Those leaders always took off time,
To thank and praise the Lord, their God.
Enjoy the Lord, enjoyed by God,
Have sweet commu-nion in His name.
True leadership does not rotate,
On people, project or problems,
True leadership, true leadership,
Is centered on-ly on the Lord!
In our Headquarters in Koume,
Each week, the lea-ders meet to pray.
They share their lives and share their food,
Sweet fellowshi-p they do enjoy.
And as they share week after week,
They'll grow to know their strengths and gifts,
Depend on each where he is strong,
A team succeeds where one would fail.

hymns.title: Sing Unto the Lord a New Song
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting.

lines: (Psalm 96: 1)
Oh, sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song,
Yes sing, Oh, sing you inhabitants of the earth
Oh, sing unto the Lord, and praise His Holy name
Proclaim his salvation day after day
Oh, sing unto the Lord a brand-new song
Oh, sing, Oh, sing to God.
Oh sing, Oh sing, Oh sing, Oh sing
You inhabitants of the earth
Sing, to the Lord, sing to the Lord
Yes, sing a brand-new song.
(Psalm 96:4)
Oh sing, Oh, sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song
Declare his glory among all the na-tions
Oh, declare His glory amongst all the nations
His marvelous deeds amongst all peoples
For gr-eat is the Lord and most worthy of praise
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.
Oh sing, Oh, sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song
He is to be feared above all the other gods
All the gods- of the earth they are just mere idols
But it's the Lord God who made the heavens
Oh, sing unto the Lord, Oh, sing brand new Song
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.
Oh sing Oh sing to the Lord sing a brand new song
Ascribe to the Lord O fa-mi-lies of nations
Ascribe unto the Lord, all glory and all strength
Ascribe to the Lord, glory for His name
Bring your offerings to God and come into His courts
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.
Oh sing Oh sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song
Bow down in worship befo-re the Lord your God
Oh tremble before Him, you people of the earth
Proclaim among the nations The Lord reigns
The world is established and cannot be shaken
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.
Oh sing, Oh, sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song
The Lord God judges the peoples in righteousness
Let the heavens rejoice, and let the ocean roar
And let the earth display its gladsomeness
Let the whole earth resound and everything in it
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.
(Psalm 96: 12)
Oh sing, Oh, sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song
