Yes sing, Oh, sing you inhabitants of the earth
Let the fields jubilate and all that is in them
Let the birds of the air sing His glory
A-ni-mals in the fields, cedars of Lebanon
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.
(Psalm 96: 13)
Oh sing, Oh, sing to the Lord, sing a brand-new song
Yes sing, Oh, sing you inhabitants of the earth
Then all the forest trees will sing for joy to Him
They'll sing before the Lord, yes for He comes
He comes to judge the world in righteousness
Oh sing, Oh, sing to God.

hymns.title: The Headquarters Spiritual Province
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF. School of Knowing and Serving God. Koume, 5th March 2016. (Tune: « The church's one foundation »)

lines: The name Spiritual Province
Of o-ur Headquarters
Is a hundred kilometres
Sur-ro-un-ding Ko-u-me
And in this large circumference
There is but on-e Church
That our ministry's building
To carry the vision.
In this Spiritual Province
Of o-ur Headquarters
The Lordship of Christ Jesus
We live and we impose
To Him we must be loyal
And Him our only Lord
Our own kingdoms we pull down
To raise His blessed reign.
The towns within the Province
Are considered quarters
Bertoua, Doume, Belabo
Batouri, Nomedjoh
Abong-Mbang and Dimako
Di-ang and others more
Are within the circumference
Of the Headquarters church.
The leaders and their people
All come with humble hearts
To the Spiritual Province
To be a part of it
And those who want their kingdoms
Will do just as they like
But they have chosen freely
To have no part in it.
The church that's of the province
Of o-ur headquarters
Has three major assignments
And major departments
The work she has to carry
And churches she must plant
She must build up the brethren
And keep the vision clear.
The work consists of planting
Churches in every place
Where there is just a hamlet
We owe that place a church
The church of our Lord Jesus
Must grow and fill the space
If God will bless our labours
Our numbers will be great.
The assigned task of some saints
Is to preach in each house
As a team they will go out
Evangelists on fire
They'll pray, they'll heal and they'll sing
The gospel of the Lord
They'll spread the good news of Christ
And bring lost souls to Him.
Another part of the work
is edi-fi-cation
Of all the churches planted
That they may live as saints
Some will invest their efforts
To building up the saints
Until the saints are matured
And useful to the Lord.
The mission of this big church
Of o-ur headquarters,
is to bring in large numbers
And bring resources too,
A church that is at the base
Must bring all that we need,
To make sure that the vision
Is fully accomplished.
The budget of any church
will reflect her vision,
This headquarters mega-church
By her gifts must proclaim,
That world conquest's her burden
She's passionate for it,
Her gifts will tell the story
Of the burden she bears.
Besides the tithes and offering
That are given each month,
Each leader will build a team
Of those who'll give with him,
We need one hundred such teams
And then one thousand teams,
Unfailingly to bring gifts
For World Conquest for Christ.
Our founding leader dreamt much
Of such a mega-church,
Committed to the vision
And would invest in it,
Nine-tenth of all her income
As he did with his own,
To provide for World Conquest
And ensure it succeeds.
Raise up then, blessed Master
O Lord of the harvest,
Churches that love their Master
And carry Your vision,
Whose budget is a witness
Of the burden they bear,
Raise such in o-ur nations
And all the nations too.
Come sing, my soul, and praise the Lord,
Who hath redeemed thee by His blood:
Delivered thee from chains that bound,
And brought thee to redemption ground.
Redemption ground, the ground of peace!
Redemption ground, oh, wondrous grace!
Here let our praise to God abound,
Who saves us on redemption ground!
Once from my God I wandered far,
And with His holy will made war:
But now my songs to God abound;
I'm standing on redemption ground.
Oh, joyous hour when God to me:
A vision gave of calvary:
My bonds were loosed, my soul unbound;
I sang upon redemption ground.
No works of merit now I plead,
But Jesus take for all my need;
No righteousness in me is found,
Except upon redemption ground.
Come, weary soul, and here find rest;
Accept redemption, and be blest:
The Christ who died, by God is crowned
To pardon on redemption ground.

hymns.title: The Names of Jesus
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald and Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting, for those who are in the Prayer Ministry. Koume, 10th July 2015.

lines: (Matthew 3: 17, John 1: 29)
Jesus Christ is the Son of God,
Jesus Christ is the Lamb of God,
Jesus Christ is the Good Shepherd,
Jesus Christ is o-ur Rock.
Jesus, blessed be Your name
Jesus, Oh, wonderful name
Jesus, the lamb that was slain
Be worship-ped, Lord forever.
(Matthew 1: 16, John 6: 35)
Jesus Christ is the Messiah.
Jesus is the Son of David,
Jesus is also called Rabbi.
Jesus is the Bread of Life
(2 Thessalonians 3: 16, Revelation 22: 16)
Jesus Christ is the Prince of peace,
Jesus is the Chief Corner-stone.
Jesus, the Bright and Morning Star,
Oh, Jesus Christ is the way.
(Colossians 1: 18; John 11: 25)
Jesus is the Head of the church,
He is the Root, yes, of David,
He is "I am", King of the Jews,
The Res-su-rec-tion and the Life.
(Isaiah 9: 5, Revelation 5: 9)
Jesus Christ is the Counsellor,
He is the First, He is the Last,
Jesus is the Lamb that was slain,
Let's all ce-le-br-ate His name.
(Hebrews 5: 6, Ephesians 2: 14)
You are the Priest forevermore,
As Mel-chi-ze-dek had ordained,
Yes, Jesus Christ is O-ur peace,
He's the Amen, He's the true God.
(Isaiah 7: 14, Revelation 1: 5)
Jesus Christ is Emmanuel,
Jesus: Israel's Comforter,
Jesus is called Faithful Witness,
He is the E-ter-nal life.
(1 Timothy 6: 15, Revelation 1: 5)
Jesus Christ is the King of kings,
Jesus Christ is the Lord of lords,
He is the Alpha Omega,
The Prince of Kings on this earth.

hymns.title: Man, a Wonderful Creature
hymns.author: Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh. WUPF. General Course. Koume, 24th December 2017.

lines: Be prai-se-eeed, be prai-se-eeed,
Be prai-se-eeed,
Oh, we praise You our Cre-a-tor.
Do we deserve it, Lord?
So much love, do we deserve it, Lord?
You made us human beings,
What honour! We praise Your Holy name.
Each minute in the world,
One hundred and se-ven people die,
But you are still alive!
Isn't God worthy of all your praise?
For every passing day,
Two hundred and eight thousand people die,
How old are you, my friend?
Praise the Lord, 'cause you're alive today.
One fifty thousand hairs
Is the number found on the head of man,
Isn't that wonderful?
Isn't God worthy of our praise today?
The hu-man ske-le-ton
Is made of two hundred and six bones
Oh, how great is our God?
He is worthy of all our praise today.
In o-ur little heads,
God has placed the brain within the skull
Eighty billion neurons,
One hundred billion connections within.
Oh brother (Oh sister), did you know?
The capacity of ten computers
Lies within o-ur brains,
Rise and praise the Lord with all of your strength.
Every person you see
Is fearfully and wonderfully made,
And each one is precious,
in the eyes of the God who's the Most High God.
The fool says in his heart:
"There is no God", he is corrupt and vile,
His thinking is futile,
And darkness has totally filled his heart.

hymns.title: Honey Bees
hymns.author: Henriette Mbarga, translated by Macrine Nyisomeh. World University of Prayer and Fasting, General Course. Koume, 15th December 2017. (Tune: "O Lord, my God" (Then sings my soul))

lines: Almighty God, when I in awesome wonder,
Consider all the bees that You have made,
We've iden-ti-fied twenty million species,
And many more, I cannot help but sing.
(Psalm 148: 5)
Oh, let us praise the name of o-ur God
He made the bees, He made the bees,
Oh, let us praise the name of o-ur God
He gives us ho-ney from the bees.
A colony is made up of the same species
It contains ten to eighty thousand bees
In every hive, there is a special chamber
To house the queen, the leader of the hive.
Two thousand eggs, the queen will lay every day
For rapid growth in numbers in the hive
She then secretes a substance called pheromone
To block the growth of any other queen.
The bees have means to transmit information
Through antenna, pheromone and through dance.
They know their tasks and changes that come with age
The older ones, they go in search of food.
When they have grown and become great in numbers
They then divide to start new colonies,
Workers who have fattened themselves with honey
Go out to seek a good place for the hive.
Then they will come, communicate through dancing,
Praising the Lord for giving them a place
Another team will go with them to confirm
Then they will build and happily move in.
The young workers do maintenance of the hive
Then they will serve as nurses for the young,
As time goes on, they become ventilators,
And finally, they go in search of food.
O Lord my God, your works are great and mighty
No one can count the wonders You have made
To God belongs all power and all wisdom,
Understanding and knowledge spring from Him.

hymns.title: The Leader's Strength
hymns.author: Henriette Mbarga, translated by Macrine Nyisomeh. World University of Prayer and Fasting, for those in the Ministry of Prayer. Koume, 27th December 2017. (Tune: "Would you be free from your burden of sin?")

lines: (Joshua 1: 1)
God called on Joshua and gave him this word:
He told him: "Be strong!" (2x)
You must arise, lead these people across
The Jordan to the promised land.
So be strong, strong, be of good courage,
Joshua, son o-f Nun,
So be strong, strong, be of good courage,
You and all the people of Israel.
(Joshua 1: 1)
In simple terms, this is what the Lord said
All depends on you (2x)
So, if you falter, they all will be ruined,
You cannot afford then to fail.
(Joshua 1: 1)
All the Lord says you are able to do
So, you must be strong (2x)
In spite of all that may happen to you,
With courage you must move ahead.
(Joshua 1: 7-8)
God then taught Joshua how he would be strong
Just obey the Lord! (2x)
The law of Moses must be in your mouth
Meditate on it day and night.
(Joshua 1: 1-7)
To be a leader you need to be strong,
O leader, "Be strong!" (2x)
Strong in your spirit and body and mind
Strong because you're called by the Lord.
You need strength, strength and great cou-rage
To be a-ble to lead
You must grow and be-come mature
To succeed and bring glory to God.
(1 Samuel 30: 3-6)
Like David all leaders need to be strong
Yes, he must be strong (2x)
When all his migh-ty men turned against him
He strengthened himself in the Lord.
In this an-guish, David turned to God
Drew his strength from the Lord,
So be strong, strong, be of good courage
Receive power to lead from the Lord.
(1 Samuel 30: 3-6)
A day may come when men turn against you
You must still be strong (2x)
When those who followed now blame and hate you
Draw courage and strength from the Lord.
(1 Samuel 30: 3-6)
The time of peace is the time we must learn
Learn to seek the Lord (2x)
If all your trust and your faith is in man
How sad when their love turns to hate.
(1 Samuel 30: 3-6)
Do not let bitterness possess your heart
You must remain strong (2x)
When people threaten to stone you to death,
God's will: is to serve them with joy.
(1 Samuel 30: 3-6)
Onward O leader whatever betide
Find strength in the Lord (2x)
Pursue the Lord then and pursue your goal
Two pillars on which you must stand.
You need strength, strength, strength,
And great courage, to be a-ble to lead,
Seek the Lord God, also seek His strength,
You shall stand when the crises shall come.
(1 Samuel 30: 3-6)
Decide that what'er your problem may be
You'll pursue the Lord, (2x)
Whatever happens to children or health
You'll follow your God and the goal.

hymns.title: The Need to Pray for Leaders
hymns.author: Henriette Mbarga, translated by Macrine Nyisomeh. WUPF, General Course, Koume, 16th December 2017. (Tune: "It is well, with my soul")

lines: The priest. Za-cha-riah was called to serve the Lord.
Each di-vi-sion came at its time
By lot he was chosen to enter the veil
Sacrifice pure incense to the Lord,
At the time of prayer (2x)
Great numbers (2x) came to pray:
(Luke 1: 10, Acts 1: 10)
Great crowds of God's people assembled that day
They stood in the outer court to pray
At the right of the altar, an angel appeared
At the time, at that time as they prayed.
(Exodus 28: 35)
The high priestly garments were specially made
Al-ter-na-ting bells round the hem.
The sound of the bells could be heard while he walked
So they'd know that he was still alive.
(Luke 1: 13)
That day, what Zacharias performed as a routine
Became an encounter with God.
Your pra-yer has been heard, the angel proclaimed
"Zacha-rias, you will ha-ve a son."
The prayers of many, (2x)
Will produce encounters from routines.
So then if we gather in great numbers to pray
The Lord will be pleased and will bless.
The routine activities of our leaders,
Will become encounters with the Lord.
To dwell in God's presence demands much from us
It needs holiness as a must
It drains ou-r spirits, it sucks our whole being
Let us pray, let us pray for leaders.
Oh, let's pray! Oh, let's pray! (2x)
Oh, let's pray! Oh, let's pray for leaders.
Oh, some have betrayed, others have fallen aside,
And o-thers have yielded to sin;
More so, others have become ti-red and dry
Very few serve from an over-flow.
Oh, let's seek the Lord and press on till the end
Our God, He cannot be replaced
Forsake broken cisterns and put them aside
Water cannot be pre-served in them
Oh, let's pray! Oh, let's pray! (2x)
Let us pray for leaders, all of them.
There were two apostles arrested by Herod
For Pe-ter the church prayed a lot
And so, he was rescued but James, he was killed
He was not borne in pray'r by the church.
We send missiona-ries into hostile ground
To carry the gospel to them
And yet the enemy, they must overcome
So, the church must lift them up in prayer.
(Psalm 72: 15)
All leaders have ne-eds: there are 4 major ones
They need wealth and favour from God,
Protection, long life, to be strong till the end
And above all they need ou-r prayer.

hymns.title: Our Goal (CMFI)
hymns.author: Henriette Mbarga, translated by Gabrielle Djiwat. World University of Prayer and Fasting for children, Koume, 6th January 2018.

lines: Christian Missionary Fellowship International O-ur goal,
To preach the Gospel to every-one who will
(pam-pam-pam)
Re a-live in o-ur generation so
(pam-pam-pam)
That 10 billion peo-ple will
Be-e reached with the Gospel
Preached in the po-wer of the Holy Spirit,
(pam-pam-pam)
Using every means of Communication:
O-ur books, O-ur tracts, O-ur magazines,
(pam-pam-pam)
O-ur CDs, DVDs,
Our TV, O-ur Radio
And Internet in the most ur-gent manner.
(pam-pam-pam)
To bring one billion people fr-o-m
250 Nations
To know
Jesus Christ as Lord and Saviour
who-o are (pam-pam-pam)
Discipled to obey Him in all things
(pam-pam-pam)
And organized, to meet in 25 million
House Churches by the year 2065.
(pam-pam-pam)
Cooperate with God through - fasting
and intercession
For a heaven rending,
Earth-sha-king, Christ glorifying glo-bal
(pam-pam-pam)
Revival, in our generation, to hasten
(pam-pam-pam)
The soon return of our Lord
Jesus Christ from Hea-ven for
(pam-pam-pam)
His bride made ready.
That's o-ur goal put into song.

hymns.title: O Jesus! You Are the King

lines: O Jesus! You are the King
And Eternal Lord
O Jesus, You are to me
My help
You have said: "Go! Be not afraid,
I will guide your way"
O my Lord
In You I'm victorious.
When in joy and all is well
Or when all goes wrong,
And my heart in agony
Groans with pain;
You are there and You are near
To wipe my tears,
With Your balm,
You heal and give me life.
O Jesus, You took our form
When You came to earth,
O Jesus
You came to seek and to save,
By Your blood
We have been cleansed of iniquity,
O our Lord
Here we acclaim Your name.

hymns.title: What Can Wash Away My Stain?

lines: What can wash away my stain?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Oh, precious is the flow,
That makes me white as snow!
No other fount I know,
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my cleansing this I see
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my pardon this my plea
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nothing can for sin atone
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Naught of good that I have done
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
This is all my hope and peace
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
This is all my righteousness
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

hymns.title: Christ the Victor
hymns.author: Translated by Roger Forteh

lines: Christ the Victor
This day we chant His victory
Christ the Victor.
He's overcome the foe of the elect
Christ's reign forever shall endure
Yea, His victory, forever endures
And His power, always endures
[To Him who sits exalted on the throne,
Be honour, praise, and glory.]x2
Conquered satan
This day we chant your demise
Conquered are you!
Prostrate are you before the King of kings
Forever you are overthrown
You are conquered, forevermore
And your weakness, always endures
[To the accuser of the elect of God
Shame and confusion be thine.]x2
Oh ye dark powers
Demons and all dominions
You are confused!
Judged and destroyed lies
Your kingdom in ruins
Conquered is Satan forevermore
You are conquered no more to rise
And your weakness always endures
[To the accuser of the elect of God
Shame and confusion be thine.]x2
Redeemed of the Lord
With all hearts and all minds in
There lies the pathway to glory
And our victory, rests unshaken
And our power, always endures
[To Him who sits exalted on the throne
Be honour, praise, and glory.]x2

hymns.title: Redeemed! How I Love to Proclaim It

lines: Redeemed! How I love to proclaim it,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb;
Redeemed through His infinite mercy,
His child and forever I am.
Redeemed, redeemed,
Redeemed by the blood of the Lamb
Redeemed, redeemed;
His child and forever I am.
Redeemed and so happy in Jesus,
No language my rapture can tell;
I know that the light of His presence
With me doth continually dwell.
I think of my blessed Redeemer,
I think of Him all the day long;
I sing for I cannot be silent.
His love is the theme of my song.
I know I shall see in His beauty,
The King in whose law I delight;
Who lovingly guardeth my foot-steps,
And giveth me songs in the night.
I know there's a crown that is waiting
In yonder bright mansion for me;
And soon with the spirits made perfect,
At home with the Lord I shall be.

hymns.title: There Is a Name I Love to Hear

lines: There is a name I love to hear,
I love to sing its worth;
It sounds like music in mine ear,
The sweetest name on earth,
Oh, how I love Jesus, (3x)
Because He first loved me.
It tells me of a Saviour's love,
Who died to set me free;
It tells me of His precious blood,
The sinner's perfect plea.
It tells me what my Father hath
In store for ev-ery day,
And though I tread a darksome path,
Yields sunshine all the way.
It tells of One whose loving heart
Can feel my deepest woe,
Who in each sorrow bears a part!
That none below can bear.
The Lord's our rock, in Him we hide:
A shelter in the time of storm!
Secure whatever ill betide:
A shelter in the time of storm!
Oh, Jesus is a rock in a weary land,
A weary land, a weary land; (2x)
Oh, Jesus is a rock in a weary land,
A shelter in the time of storm!
A shade by day, defence by night,
A shelter in the time of storm!
No fears alarm, no foes affright:
A shelter in the time of storm!
The raging storms may round us beat:
A shelter in the time of storm!
We'll never leave our safe retreat,
A shelter in the time of storm!
O Rock Divine, O Refuge dear:
A shelter in the time of storm!
Be Thou our Helper ever near,
A shelter in the time of storm!

hymns.title: King of My Life, I Crown Thee Now

lines: King of my life, I crown Thee now,
Thine shall the glory be;
Lest I forget Thy thorn-crowned brow
Lead me to Calvary.
Lest I forget Gethsemane,
Lest I forget Thine agony,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Lead me to Calvary.
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid
Tenderly mourned and wept
Angels in robes of white arrayed,
Guarded Thee whilst Thou slept
Let me, like Mary, through the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee
Show to me now the empty tomb
Lead me to Calvary.
May I be willing, Lord, to bear,
Daily my cross for Thee;
Even Thy cup of grief to share,
Thou hast borne all for me.
Fill me, O Lord, with Thy desire
For all who know not Thee;
Then touch my lips with holy fire,
To speak of Calvary.

hymns.title: Dying on the Cross of Calvary

lines: Suffering, dying on the cross of Calvary,
Jesus set me free from satan's slavery;
Washing sin and shame away,
Cleansing heart and soul to stay
In forever, making me a child of God.
Therefore, come!
Friend, come a-long with me!
Therefore, come!
Friend, come along with me!
Therefore, come!
Oh friend, come!
Sinner, walk with me
The narrow road of life!
What the Lord has done for me on Calvary
Brought salvation through-out eternity.
Though the devil still may fight, Jesus conquers at my side:
Nothing ever shall destroy my faith in God.
Worldly pleasures, earthly follies be ye gone;
Satisfaction and true gladness grant ye none,
I will walk the narrow road that my Lord before me trod,
Though it be the way of suffering and the cross.
Soon, one day, my race of faith on earth will end;
Gladly then my knees before my Lord I'll bend.
Then rejoicing I shall see throughout all eternity
Him whose love, so great, has dying purchased me.

hymns.title: The Lord Has Done So Much for Me

lines: The Lord has done so much for me,
Forever shall I love Him.
He died for me on Calvary;
Forever shall I love Him.
Forever shall I love Him,
My Saviour, my Saviour.
Forever shall I love Him,
For He did so much for me.
He saved my life from death and hell;
Forever shall I love Him.
He healed my soul and made me well;
Forever shall I love Him.
He keeps and guards me every day;
Forever shall I love Him;
Restores my strength and leads the way;
Forever shall I love Him.
There is no friend like Christ, my Lord;
Forever shall I love Him.
He is My stronghold and support;
Forever shall I love Him.
Though many might forsake You Lord
Forever shall I love You.
In spite of any painful lot
Forever shall I love You.

hymns.title: Have You Been to Jesus for the Cleansing Power?

lines: Have you been to Jesus for the cleansing power?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you fully trusting in His grace this hour?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you washed in the blood?
In the soul, cleansing blood of the Lamb?
Are your garments spotless, are they as white as snow?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Are you walking daily by the Saviour's side?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
Do you rest each moment in the Crucified?
Are you washed in the blood of the Lamb?
When the Bridegroom cometh will your robes be white?
Pure and white in the blood of the Lamb?
Will your soul be ready for the mansions bright?
And be washed in the blood of the Lamb?

hymns.title: Would You Be Free from Your Burden of Sin?

lines: Would you be free from your burden of sin?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you o'er evil a victory win?
There's wonderful power in the blood.
There is power, power,
Wonder-working power
In the blood, of the Lamb;
There is power, power,
Wonder-working power
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
Would you be free from your passion and pride?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Come for a cleansing to Calvary's tide,
There's wonderful power in the blood.
Would you be whiter, much whiter than snow?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Sin-stains are lost in its life-giving flow,
There's wonderful power in the blood.
Would you do service for Jesus your King?
There's power in the blood, power in the blood;
Would you live daily His praises to sing?
There's wonderful power in the blood.
I hear Thy welcome voice,
That calls me, Lord, to Thee
For cleansing in Thy precious blood
That flowed on Calvary.
I am coming, Lord,
Coming now to Thee:
Trusting only in the blood
That flowed on Calvary.
Though coming, weak and vile,
Thou, dost my strength assure;
Thou dost my vileness fully cleanse,
Till spotless all and pure.
'Tis Jesus calls me on
To perfect faith and love,
To perfect hope, and peace, and trust,
For earth and heaven above.
All hail, atoning blood!
All hail, redeeming grace!
All hail, the gift of Christ our Lord
Our strength and righteousness!
I've wandered far away from God,
Now I'm coming home;
The paths of sin too long I've trod,
Lord, I'm coming home.
Coming home, coming home
Never more to roam;
The paths of sin too long I've trod,
Lord, I'm coming home.
I've wasted many precious years,
Now I'm coming home;
I now repent with bitter tears,
Lord, I'm coming home.
I've tired of sin and straying, Lord
Now I'm coming home;
I'll trust Thy love, believe Thy Word,
Lord, I'm coming home.
My soul is sick, my heart is sore,
Now I'm coming home;
My strength renew, my hope restore,
Lord, I'm coming home.
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Thou art the Potter,
I am the clay.
Mould me and make me
After Thy will,
While I am waiting,
Yielded and still.
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Search me and try me,
Master, to-day!
Whiter than snow, Lord,
Wash me just now,
As in Thy presence
Humbly I bow.
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Wounded and weary,
Help me, I pray.
Power, all power
Surely is Thine!
Touch me and heal me,
Saviour divine!
Have Thine own way, Lord!
Have Thine own way!
Hold o'er my being
Absolute sway!
Fill with Thy Spirit
Till all shall see
Christ only, always,
Living in me!

hymns.title: Oh Happy Day That Fixed My Choice

lines: Oh, happy day that fixed my choice
On Thee, my Saviour and my God!
Well may this glowing heart rejoice,
And tell its raptures all abroad.
Happy day (2x)
When Jesus washed my sins away!
He taught me how to watch and pray.
And live rejoicing every day
Happy day (2x)
When Jesus washed my sins away!
'Tis done, the great transaction's done,
I am my Lord's and He is mine;
He drew me, and I followed on,
Charmed to confess the voice Divine.
Now rest, my long-divided heart,
Fixed on this blissful centre, rest;
Nor ever from thy Lord depart,
With Him of every good possessed.
High heav'n, that heard the solemn vow,
That vow renewed shall daily hear,
Till in life's latest hour I bow,
And bless in death a bond so dear.
Nearer, my God, to Thee,
Nearer to Thee!
E'en though it be a cross
That raiseth me,
Still all my song shall be
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!
Though, like the wanderer,
The sun gone down,
darkness be over me,
My rest a stone,
yet in my dreams I'll be
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!
There let the way appear
Steps unto heaven:
All that Thou sendest me
In mercy given;
Angels to beckon me
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!
Then with my waking thoughts
Bright with Thy praise,
Out of my stony griefs.
Bethel I'll raise;
So by my woes to be
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!
Or if on joyful wing
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon, and stars forgot,
Upward I fly.
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer, my God, to Thee!
Nearer to Thee!
Nearer, still nearer
Close to Thy heart,
Draw me, my Saviour,
So precious Thou art;
Fold me, Oh fold me
Close to Thy breast.
[Shelter me safe
In that "Haven of Rest"] (x2)
Nearer, still nearer,
Nothing I bring
Naught as an offering
To Jesus, my King;
Only my sinful,
Now contrite heart
Grant me the cleansing
Thy blood doth impart.
Nearer, still nearer,
Lord to be Thine;
Sin with its follies
I gladly resign:
All of its pleasures,
Pomp and its pride.
Give me but Jesus,
My Lord crucified.
Nearer, still nearer,
While life shall last,
Till all its struggles
And trials are past;
Then through eternity
Ever I'll be
Nearer, my Saviour,
Still nearer to Thee.
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice but Thine
Can peace afford.
I need Thee, Oh, I need Thee.
Ev'ry hour I need Thee.
Oh, bless me now, my Saviour!
I come to Thee.
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Stay Thou near by;
Temptations lose their power
When Thou art nigh.
I need Thee ev'ry hour
In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide
Or life is vain.
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Teach me Thy will;
And Thy rich promises
In me fulfill.
I need Thee ev'ry hour,
Most Holy One;
Oh make me Thine indeed,
Thou blessed Son.

hymns.title: When We Walk with the Lord

lines: When we walk with the Lord,
In the light of His Word,
What a glory He sheds on our way!
While we do His good will
He abides with us still,
And with all who will trust and obey.
Trust and obey;
For there's no other way
To be happy in Jesus,
But to trust and obey.
Not a shadow can rise
Not a cloud in the skies,
But His smile quickly drives it away;
Not a doubt nor a fear,
Not a sigh nor a tear,
Can abide while we trust and obey.
Not a burden we bear,
Not a sorrow we share,
But our toil He doth richly repay;
Not a grief nor a loss,
Not a frown nor a cross,
But is blest if we trust and obey.
But we never can prove
The delights of His love
Until all on the altar we lay;
For the favour He shows,
And the joy He bestows,
Are for them who will trust and obey.
Then in fellowship sweet
We will sit at His feet,
Or we'll walk by His side in the way:
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go,
Never fear, only trust and obey.

hymns.title: We Have Heard the Joyful Sound

lines: We have heard the joyful sound:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Tell the message all around:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Bear the news to every land.
Climb the steeps and cross the waves;
Onward! 'tis our Lord's command:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Waft it on the rolling tide:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Say to sinners far and wide:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Sing, ye islands of the sea,
Echo back, ye ocean caves;
Earth shall keep her Jubilee:
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Sing above the toil and strife,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
By His death and endless life,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Sing it softly through the gloom,
When the heart for mercy craves;
Sing in triumph o'er the tomb,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Give the winds a mighty voice,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Let the nations now rejoice,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!
Shout salvation full and free,
To every strand that ocean laves
This our song of victory,
Jesus saves! Jesus saves!

hymns.title: Work, for the Night Is Coming!

lines: Work, for the night is coming!
Work thro' the morning hours;
Work while the dew is sparkling:
Work 'mid springing flow'rs;
Work while the day grows brighter,
Under the glowing sun;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man's work is done.
Work, for the night is coming!
Work thro' the sunny noon;
Fill brightest hours with labour;
Rest comes sure and soon.
Give ev'ry flying minute
Something to keep in store;
Work, for the night is coming,
When man works no more.
Work, for the night is coming!
Under the sunset skies,
While their bright tints are glowing;
Work, for daylight flies;
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Fadeth to shine no more;
Work while the night is darkening,
When man's work is o'er.
Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.
Christ, the Royal Master,
Leads against the foe;
Forward into battle
See His banners go.
Onward, Christian soldiers!
Marching as to war,
Looking unto Jesus,
Who is gone before.
Like a mighty army
Moves the church of God:
Brothers, we are treading
Where the saints have trod;
We are not divided,
All one body we.
One in hope and doctrine,
One in charity.
At the name of Jesus
Satan's host doth flee;
On then, Christian soldiers,
On to victory!
Hell's foundations quiver
At the shout of praise:
Brothers, lift your voices,
Loud your anthems raise!
Crowns and thrones may perish,
Kingdoms rise and wane;
But the church of Jesus
Constant will remain:
'Gates that church prevail;
We have Christ's own promise,
And that cannot fail.
Join the rang you young men
With a holy zeal
Be not slack or lukewarm
Nor of fearful heart.
For Jesus our Captain
Goes before His rangs
All things are possible
To each who has faith.
Onward then, ye people,
Join our happy throng;
Blend with ours your voices
In the triumph song:
Glory, praise and honour
Unto Christ the King,
This through countless ages
Men and angels sing.
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Now to Thy saints appear!
Oh, speak with power to every soul,
And let Thy people hear!
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
While here to Thee we bow;
Descend, O gracious Lord, descend!
Oh come, and bless us now!
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Exalt Thy precious name!
And may Thy love in every heart
Be kindled to a flame!
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
And bless to all Thy Word
And may its pure and sacred truth
In living faith, be heard!
Revive Thy work, O Lord!
Give Pentecostal showers!
Be Thine the glory, Thine alone!
The blessing, Lord, be ours!

hymns.title: When the Trumpet of the Lord

lines: When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound
And time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks eternal, bright and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather
Over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.
When the roll... is called up yon...der,
When the roll... is called up yon... der,
When the roll... is called up yon... der,
When the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.
On that bright and cloudless morning
When the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share
When His chosen ones shall gather
To their homes beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there,
Let me labour for the Master
From the dawn till setting sun,
Let me talk of all His wondrous love and care.
Then, when all of life is over,
And my work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder,
I'll be there.

hymns.title: I Know Not Why God's Wondrous Grace

lines: I know not why God's wondrous grace
To me He hath made known,
Nor why, unworthy as I am,
He claimed me for His own.
But I know whom I have believed, and
Am persuaded that He is able
To keep that which I've committed
Unto Him against that day.
I know not how this saving faith
To me He did impart,
or how believing in His Word
Wrought peace within my heart.
I know not how the Spirit moves,
Convincing men of sin,
Revealing Jesus through the Word,
Creating faith in Him.
I know not what of good or ill
May be reserved for me,
Of weary ways or golden days,
Before His face I see.

hymns.title: When All My Labours and Trials Are O'er

lines: When all my labours and trials are o'er,
And I am safe on that beautiful shore,
Just to be near the dear Lord I adore,
Will through the ages be glory for me.
Oh, that will be... glory for me..,
Glory for me.., glory for me..
When by His grace I shall look on His face,
That will be glory be glory for me!
When by the gift of His infinite grace,
I am accorded in heaven a place,
Just to be there and to look on His face,
Will through the ages be glory for me.
Friends will be there I have loved long ago
Joy like a river around me will flow;
Yet, just a smile from my Saviour, I know,
Will through the ages be glory for me.
Abide with me: fast falls the eventide;
The darkness deepens; Lord, with me abide:
When other helpers fail, and comforts flee,
Help of the helpless, oh, abide with me!
Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day;
Earth's joys grow dim; its glories pass away,
Change and decay in all around I see:
O Thou, who changest not, abide with me.
I need Thy presence every passing hour;
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's power?
Who like Thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, oh, abide with me!
I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no bitterness:
Where is death's sting? Where, grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if Thou abide with me
Hold Thou Thy cross before my closing eyes,
Shine through the gloom, and point me to the skies;
Heaven's morning breaks and earth's vain shadows flee
In life and death, O Lord, abide with me.

hymns.title: I Am the Shepherd
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald.

lines: I am the Shepherd, My children you'll lack nothing
I came to earth so that my sheep can all have life
And life in abundance,
That they'll have abundance
I am the Good Shepherd, from up above
And every Good Shepherd,
Gives his life for the sheep.
Hallelujah, amen.
Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah,
Hallelujah, hallelujah, hallelujah, amen.
I am the e Shepherd and yes, I know all My sheep
I am the Good Shepherd,
Yes, all My sheep know Me
My Father knows Me well and yes.
I know Him too.
And I lay down My life, for all My sheep
None takes my life from me, I chose to
lay it down.
Hallelujah, amen.
The hired hand, all he does is abandon them
And so, the wolf comes around
And de-vou-rs them.
The hired hand just runs, for he is tem-po-ra-l
He never puts himself at risk for them
The sheep are not his own, for he's Not
the Shepherd. Hallelujah, amen.
(John 10:5)
Verily, verily I say unto you all sheep
And I am telling you I am the she-ep's gate
All those who came before were
Thieves, they were robbers.
I'm telling you that they were all robbers
And this is why the sheep never
Listened to them. Hallelujah, amen.
(John 10:9)
I am the gate and all those who enter through Me
Will all be saved, they will come in and then come out
Having found green pasture, yes pasture they will find
And they will all be full, be satisfied.
I am the Bread of life who came down from heaven.
Hallelujah, amen.
I'm telling you that I have other sheep outside,
And all these sheep are not yet of My sheepfold.
And so, I have to bring them, bring each one of them,
So they can hear my voice and follow Me.
And there will be one flock with only one Shepherd.
Hallelujah, amen.
(Hebrews 13: 20- 21)
O Jesus, You are the great Shepherd of the sheep
O God of peace, who by power raised Jesus up
And who has placed His Son to sit at His right hand
And given Him a name above all names
O Jesus, our Saviour,
We give You the glory for all eternity.
God is good, He has been so good,
To His people, rise up and praise the Lord.
(Psalm 136: 2)
Oh, praise the Lord, the God of gods,
For His mercies endure forever,
To Him who alone does great wonders
Praise the Lord, praise ye the Lord of lords.
Oh, praise the Lord, who made Heaven,
By His understanding, He made Heaven,
Who spread the Earth upon the waters!
His mercies they endure forever.
The Lord's the One who made the light
The sun, He made to rule the day
And His mercies endure forever
And the moon and stars, to rule the night.
The Lord struck down the Egyptians
And His mercies endure forever.
He brought Israel out from among them
With a mighty hand and outstretched arm,
The Lord struck down Egypt's firstborn
And His mercies endure forever.
The Lord struck down Pharaoh's first born
Oh, give Him praise, the Almighty God.
Our great God parted the Red Sea
And His mercies endure forever,
He led Israel to pass through it
And they passed through it in victory.
The Lord struck down the mighty kings
His mercies endure forever,
Sihon king of the Amorites
O-ur Lord killed Og, king of Bashan.
To the One who remembered us,
His mercies endure forever
Thought of us in our low estate,
Praise the Lord, the great God of heaven.
Our God gives life to all creatures
His mercies endure forever
He gives them food, food in season
Oh, give thanks to the God of Heaven.

hymns.title: The Word of God for Yaounde
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald. (Tune: 'Give me that old time Gospel')

lines: Please, receive O Yaounde (3x)
The Word of God for you.
(Isaiah 54: 1)
Oh, rejo-ice, O Yaounde
For the Lord has made you fruitful
Sing a song and shout for joy
Your barrenness has gone.
(Isaiah 54: 2)
Enlarge your house, build an addition
Spread your tents, expand your dwelling
Take your cords and make them longer
Establish holiness.
(Isaiah 54 :3)
You will spread out to the right
You will spread out to the left
Your posterity will possess
Will possess all nations.
(Isaiah 54; 4)
You'll no longer be disgraced
You will forget all your shame,
All your past shame is behind you
Yaounde, do not fear.
(Isaiah 54: 5)
Your Creator is your bridegroom
His Name is the Lord Almighty,
He's the Lord of all the Earth
The God of Is-ra-el.

hymns.title: The Way of the Cross
hymns.author: Translated by ET, WUPF Koume, 11th November 2018.

lines: The way of the cross is ou-r way,
The way calls for stripping all
And of dear ones from our heart.
Of self and of the world,
It's for the glory of the Lord,
And we will not fail our Lord
At all cost to ourselves,
We will obey.
Our move ahead's against the tide,
Through almost crushed by pressures
We must be straining every hour,
We lift our eyes to our Lord.
Therefore, we can't be overcome
Our God's the Living God,
By his right hand stretched forth
We are victors.
To father and mum: goodbye!
To my dear friends, it's adieu!
Am on the way to the battle field.
I hear a voice calling me.
I hear a voice of the Captain,
That's calling out to me,
Here I am my Jesus,
I will follow!
I've found a friend; oh such a Friend!
He loved me ere I knew Him;
He drew me with the cords of love,
And thus He bound me to Him;
And round my heart still closely twine
Those ties which naught can sever
For I am His, and He is mine,
For ever and for ever.
I've found a Friend; oh such a Friend!
He bled, He died to save me;
And not alone the gift of life,
But His own self He gave me.
Naught that I have mine own I call
I hold it for the Giver;
My heart, my strength, my life, my all,
Are His, and His for ever.
I've found a Friend; oh such a Friend!
All power to Him is given,
To guard me on my onward course
And bring me safe to heaven.
Th' eternal glories gleam afar,
To nerve my faint endeavour;
So now to watch, to work, to war!
And then to rest for ever!
I've found a Friend; oh such a Friend!
So kind, and true, and tender,
So wise a Counsellor and Guide,
So mighty a Defender!
From Him, who loves me now so well
What power my soul shall sever?

No! I am His for ever.

lines: I hear my glorious Saviour say,

I drank the gall thy debt to pay,
"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me."
"Come, cast on Me your many cares,
"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me."

"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me."
Though you have sinned I pardon you,

"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me!"

"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me

"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me"

"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me!"

"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me."
