"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me."
Behold I have a crown in store for you,
"Follow Me, follow Me, follow Me."
And My Father's wondrous presence,
The home prepared for My very own,
Then you will sit with Me on the throne
And rejoice for having followed Me.

hymns.title: Well-Done Good and Faithful
hymns.author: Z. T. Fomum. Obala, 15th May 1982.

lines: Well-done good and faithful servant,
You gave your all for Me.
You suffered shame on earth for Me,
You were faithful to the end.
Enter now into My glory,
Prepared for My very own,
Come into My very presence,
And be lost in My love.
Sit at the banquet I've prepared,
For My special lovers,
Sit at My own very table,
And eat from My own plate.
Behold the joy of My Father,
The home prepared for you,
Behold its wondrous beauty,
And it is all for you.
Here flows the river of life,
And it flows just for you,
Here grows that evergreen tree,
My Father's plant for you.
Together we will live and reign,
On My Father's great throne,
Angels shall serve us together,
Through all eternity.
Then through all eternity,
Reigning on the throne with Me,
You'll know that it was all by grace,
And praise the eternal King.

hymns.title: You Are God, You Are God
hymns.author: Henriette Mbarga. Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh From the family worship led by Colette Menye World University of Prayer and Fasting for those in the Prayer Ministry. Koume, 20th June 2018. (Tune: "He is King, He is risen.")

lines: You are God, You are God,
You are so-ve-reign, You are God,
In the most painful, situ-a-tions,
I declare that You are God.
You are God, You are God,
You alone are sovereign, You are God,
In my family, in my very life,
I proclaim that You are God.
You are God, You are God,
You alone are sovereign, You are God,
My difficulties, and my state of health,
Proclaim that You are God.
You are God, You are God,
You are so-ve-reign, You are God,
Even when I pray, and no answers come,
I proclaim that You are God.
You are God. You are God,
You alone are sovereign, You are God,
There are still loved ones, who have not believed,
I proclaim that You are God.
You are God, You are God,
You're the Sovereign God, You are God,
Though I feel the
O Lord, You remain God.
You are God, You are God,
You're the Sovereign God, You are God,
When I understand, when I cannot see,
O Lord, You remain God.

hymns.title: Psalm 65
hymns.author: Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh From the family worship led by Madeleine Nkah World University of Prayer and Fasting for those who are in the Prayer Ministry. Koume, 18th June 2018. (Tune: "He leadeth me")

lines: (Psalm 65: 1)
O Lord our God, with joyful hearts,
In Zion we shall praise Your name.
To You our vows will be fulfilled,
The God of heaven and of earth.
O Lord our God, with joyful hearts,
In Zion we shall praise Your name.
To You our vows will be fulfilled,
O God of heaven and of earth.
When we were overwhelmed by sin,
You for-gave our ini-qui-ty
Therefore, all men will come to You,
The one who hears and an-swers pray'r.
(Psalm 65: 4)
How bles-sed are the ones You choose,
Those You admit into Your courts,
That they may in Your presence dwell,
Drink of Your goodness-joy abounds.
(Psalm 65: 4)
Your holy temple, Lord, our God,
Satisfies us beyond measure,
The holiness of your presence,
So fills us, O Lord, You are good.
(Psalm 65: 5)
In Your goodness, O Lord our God,
You answer us with awesome deeds.
The Hope of the ends of the earth,
Is the Lord of the furthest seas!
(Psalm 65: 8)
Dwellers of the ends of the earth,
They stand in awe of Your wonders, Lord,
You fill the land with songs of joy,
Resounding now from East to West.
(Psalm 65:9)
The earth is Yours, You care and do,
Pour upon it Your show'rs of rain,
And enrich soils to make plants grow,
The small and great are blessed by You.
You crown the year with goodness, Lord
Your path with a-bundance o'erflow,
Yes, shouts and songs of joy resound,
To ho-nour You, O Living God.

hymns.title: A Clear Conscience
hymns.author: Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh From a teaching given by Emilia Tendo WUPF for those In the ministry of prayer and fasting Koume, 20th June, 2018. (Tune: "Would you be free from your burden of sin?")

lines: (1Timothy 1: 19)
Would you become a minister of pray'r?
Who pleases the Lord (2x)
Would you draw near to the Lord without fear?
You need that your conscience be clear.
A clear con-science towards God and man,
Is a must, is a must!
If your heart is not condemning you,
You shall be a minister of pray'r.
Paul, when arrested this is what he said:
I strive all the time, (2x)
To have a conscience that's void of offence.
Toward God and toward all men.
(Acts 23: 1)
Men and brothers with all good conscience,
To this very day, (2x)
This is the way I have served before God,
This is the testimony of Paul.
Our consciences must be without reproach,
If we want to pray, (2x)
Then when we draw near to God and we pray
Surely He will grant our request.
(Matthew 6: 2-6)
Hypocrites love to be seen when they pray
Do not be like them, (2x)
For they repeat many words before God,
All that does not mean you have prayed!
(Matthew 5:24)
The Spirit says: you I have hurt your brother,
Go, repent to him, (2x)
Instead you go to the house of prayer,
To pray? No, to make noise in vain!
(Matthew 6: 7)
Filling Up hours on the pray-er chain,
Does not mean you pray, (2x)
You must ensure that your conscience is clear,
So that you may pray, truly pray.
(Matthew 6: 14 - 15)
When there is bitterness deep in the heart,
It disqualifies, (2x)
To raise up prayer to God in the truth,
It becomes a must to forgive.
(Matthew 5: 23)
If you remember when you come to God,
With your off-e-rings, (2x)
That your brother has something against you,
First go, be recon-ciled to Him.
(John 15: 4, John 15: 16b)
We must be people who obey the Lord,
If we want to pray, (2x)
Prayer must flow from communion with God,
That is when the answer will come.
O Lord I accept to take up my cross,
choose to forgive, (2x)
I put an end to all pride and all self,
Humble myself so I can pray.
I renounce all pride and all self,
I will pray, (2x)
I shall watch, over my conscience
I shall receive answers when I pray!

hymns.title: The Clothing of a Minister to Children
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald. World University of Prayer and Fasting for the Ministers of children. Koume, 6th February 2018.

lines: The clothing of a minister to children
Their clothing must be made of bright colours
And anyone who ministers to children
They should be dressed all in colours that shine
For dark colours and dull colours
They scare the children that you teach
Let's dress ourselves in flowers and joy
As ministers to the children.
The most important aspect of the dressing
That all ministers to children should have
Must be a smile, enthu-siasm and joy,
And deep affection for every child,
And phy-si-cal contact with them
While still maintaining purity
But contact that's affec-tion-ate
With con-scious-ness of balance too.
The Christian character we have is clothing
That ministers to children must always wear
Just like the priests we read of in the Bible
Were always dressed, dressed to shine, dressed to shine
Pray that you will be dressed with charm
And that you'll draw children to you
You'll draw them by an aroma
Of character and tenderness.
A minister to children who is joyful
Changes children and he gives them morals
Let's be joyful not only on the surface
Yes, be joyful at home and at work
But you must also have substance
And have cha-ris-ma and have joy
Yes, you must have spi-ri-tual me
So you will not just entertain,

hymns.title: I Love This Family of God

lines: I love this family of God.
So closely knitted into one.
They have taken me into their hearts,
And I'm so glad to be
A part of this great family.
Hand in hand together we will stand.
I need you to build this family.
You need me to build this family.
Higher and higher we will go.
Stronger and stronger we will be.
Brighter and brighter we will shine.
Don't you know you mean so much to me?

hymns.title: Thrice Holy One
hymns.author: Unknown Author.

lines: Thrice Holy One, to You I come,
With all of my heart, Lord (2x)
You have asked me to seek,
Continually Your face, Lord.
Touch, Melt My heart,
With power divine and mighty
Spirit of God;
Come help and uphold me.
Eternal God, O God of love.
You formed, created me (2x)
The earth, sky and sea.
Display Your power and wisdom,
But man, You made
In God's very own likeness,
And to love You;
You gave to me a heart.
Thy bountiful care was right there
When from the womb I came (2x)
Day and night, You were there
And watched my fragile being
Traced all my paths
And guided me with favour
Your grace and love saw me
Through every day.
But blessed Lord, how very soon,
I forget all Your care! (2x)
Your loving kindness too!
And have withstood Your grace,
Have provoked and I've grieved You,
So vile I am; and full of pride, of wonderings
Rebellion, too my stubbornness.
You know.
Be-fore Thy mer-cy seat,
I come though weak and vile, (2x)
But Your mer-cy O God,
Relieves me of my misery,
For Christ has died,
Tis finished! He died for me,
The love of God the slain Lamb,
And the shed blood.
O Christ my Lord!
You hear My voice
Lifting up my load of sin (2x)
Now my conscience is free
Again I call God, Father!
The Lamb of God!
The "Amen" of God's promise
All hail! All hail! The gift of Christ our Lord.

hymns.title: I See Before Me Just Two Wills
hymns.author: Z.T. Fomum, 8th September 1987.

lines: I see before me just two wills
The will of God and the enemy's
No other will besides these two
I'll do Your will. (3x)
I will not bring in my own will
For my will would be the enemy's
I take Your will, my Lord, for mine
I'll do Your will. (3x)
I give myself to seek Your will
In all I think and say and do
And when it's found my choice is made
I'll do Your will. (3x)

hymns.title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds

lines: Blest be the tie that binds
Our hearts in Christian love,
The fellowship of kindred minds
Is like to that above.
Before our Father's throne,
We pour our ardent prayers,
Our fears, our hopes, our aims are one,
Our comforts and our cares.
We share our mutual woes,
Our mutual burdens bear,
And often for each other flow,
The sympathizing tear.
When we asunder part
It gives us inward pain
But we shall still be joined in heart
And hope to meet again.

hymns.title: To Him Who Loves Us
hymns.author: Translated by Emilia Tendo.

lines: (Revelation 1: 5-8, Revelation 22: 17)
To Him who lo-oves us,
And freed us from all our sins,
By His blood that He did shed,
Made us a kingdom of priest.
Thine is glory and power Lord
For e-ver and for e-ver
The Bride says: Lord, come! (2)
O come wipe off our tears,
Come and stablish Your kingdom
Come Lord! Maranatha! come! (2x)
Look! He's coming with the clouds
And every eye will see Him,
Even those who pierced Him.
will see Him! For sure He'll come!
He's the Alpha! Th' Omega,
The Lord God, Lord Almighty,
Who is, was and is to come!
The Lord God, Lord Almighty.
Your heart will be found, where your treasure is laid,
Do not be foolish! where you invest,
in heaven or earth, your future depends,
Now is the time to choose aright.
Money cannot fulfill,
Your deepest desires,
God has true tre-a-sures,
For your heart's desire
If all your dream is gold,
You're in for a shock,
On judgement day, you'll know
That money can't buy God.
The Christ of God came, to set captives free,
From love of money, He'll set you free.
The rich are all scared! scared to lose their wealth
Which's like a mist that they cannot hold.
Lay up for yourself, treasures in heaven
That's the good counsel of God Most High
Listen and obey, and be wise, my friend
So now prepare, for eternity.

hymns.title: What a Wonderful Saviour Is Jesus

lines: What a wonderful Saviour is Jesus,
In compassion He died for me,
With His life He purchased my pardon,
On that cursed rugged cross He died.
He was nailed on the cross for me,
He was nailed on the cross for me,
Took my sins on Himself and He set me free,
He was nailed on the cross for me.
From the throne He came down to a lost world,
For the redemptive work of God,
Stripped Himself of His glory and nature
Tis the price that He paid for me.
Was despised and rejected by all men,
For my iniquities was crushed,
Thus, He says to me: "See, I love you",
So He died and I am redeemed.
He proclaimed on the cross: "It is finished!"
Full salvation was accomplished,
From the grave He ascended to heaven.
We await Him, He's coming soon!

hymns.title: There Is a Sunshine in My Soul Today

lines: There's a sunshine in my soul to-day
More glorious and bright
Than glows in any earthly sky,
For Jesus is my light.
Oh, there's sun-shine, blessed sun-shine
When the peaceful, happy moments roll,
When Jesus shows His smiling face,
There is sunshine in my soul.
There is music in my soul to-day,
A carol to my King;
And Jesus, listening, can hear,
The songs I cannot sing.
There is a springtime in my soul to-day
For, when the Lord is near
The dove of peace sings in my heart.
The flowers of grace appear.
There is gladness in my soul to-day,
And hope, and praise, and love,
For blessings which He gives me now,
For joys laid up above.
Come unto me! It is the Saviour's voice,
The Lord of life, who bids thy heart rejoice,
O weary heart, with heavy cares oppress.
Come unto Me, and I will give you rest.
Come unto Me, come unto Me,
Come unto Me, and I will give you rest,
I will give you rest, I will give you rest.
Weary with life's long struggle full of pain,
Oh, doubting soul, thy Saviour calls again;
Thy doubts shall vanish and thy sorrows cease.
Come unto Me, and I will give you peace.
Come unto Me, come unto Me,
Come unto Me, and I will give you peace,
I will give you peace, I will give you peace.
Oh! dying man, with guilt and sin dismayed,
With conscience wakened, of thy God afraid;
Twixt hopes and fear, Oh end the anxious strife.
Come unto Me, and I will give you life.
Come unto Me, come unto Me,
Come unto Me, and I will give you life,
I will give you life, I will give you life.
Life, rest and peace, the flowers of deathless bloom,
The Saviour gives us, not beyond the tomb;
But here and now; on earth some glimpse is given
Of joys which wait us through the gates of heaven.
Come unto Me, come unto me,
Come unto Me, and I will give you joy,
I will give you joy. I will give you joy.
Jesus is the model, for the youths today,
Model of holiness, of consecration,
Model of obedience and of purity,
Model in being, in doing.
Our Lord in His great love,
From His throne sent down His Son,
He came to seek and to find,
The lost souls of the world,
The youths, the children, the adults
Who are bound by the chains of sin,
Today He is here to change,
All youths who turn to Him.
One day He too was your age,
Yet He lived a sinless life,
The world, its pleasures and money
Were not His desires.
He lived to serve His Father
And to serve the sinners too.
Today He is here to change,
All youths who turn to Him.
O Lord we have come here,
To seek Your face today,
We desire to find You,
Know You and love You.
The vigour of our youth
Is beautiful but fragile,
We want to be transformed,
Have You as our model.
Jesus the model.
O Lord we have come here,
To seek Your face today,
Before we stand Lord.
Yes, take our lives, O Lord
We give our lives, O Lord
We give our young lives
To you, to Your purposes
Qualify us dear Lord,
To serve You our King.
Sanctify us, O Lord, (You are the model!)
Purify us, O Lord, (You are the model!)
Deliver us, O Lord, (You are the model)
Revive us, O Lord, (You are the model)
Transform us, O Lord, (You are the model!)
Restore us, O Lord, (You are the model!)
Qualify us, O Lord, (You are the model!)
Send us, forth O Lord. (You are the model!)
Here are we Lord,
Ready to obey You,
Enrol o-ur lives in Your army
Let Your fire burn in the heart of our lives
Exercise our hands in Your battles
Let all over the world,
A bil-lion people
Get to know Jesus,
As Lord and Saviour
And render Him total
Obedience in all things
Yes, by 2065, we must all conquer.
The world to Jesus (6x)
We shall go all over the world,
Set ablaze with the Holy Spirit
Our talents, time, treasures,
Will all be invested,
Farewell to the chasing after the wind
Let the strength of our youthfulness
Help us in the conquest,
Of the world to Jesus.
We come to Your feet,
To lay our passions,
All our ambitions, our future,
And we submit our lives to Your perfect will,
Incline our hearts to Your battles,
Let all over the world,
A billion people,
Get to know Jesus Christ,
As their Lord and Saviour,
And render Him total,
Obedience in all things,
By 2065 we must all conquer.
You call us unto,
Your great commission,
To go and win the world to Christ,
To go and make of all nations disciples,
Here we are, O Lord, Oh, send us forth,
Let all over the world,
A billion people,
Get to know Jesus Christ,
As their Lord and Saviour,
And render Him total,
Obedience in all things,
By 2065 we must all conquer.
We shall go to Africa, Asia, Europe,
To all the 6 continents to preach the gospel
We shall get to the 250 nations,
Accept us as Your missionaries,
Let all over the world.
A billion people,
Get to know Jesus Christ
As their Lord and Saviour,
And render Him total,
Obedience in all things,
By 2065 we must all conquer.
How firm a foundation, ye saints of the Lord.
Is laid for your faith, in His excellent word!
What more can He say, than to you He hath said
To you, who for refuge, to Jesus have fled?
Fear not, I am with Thee; Oh, be not dismayed!
For I am Thy God, I will still give Thee aid;
I'll strengthen Thee, help Thee, and cause Thee to stand.
Upheld by My gracious, omnipotent hand.
(Isaiah 43: 1)
When through the deep waters I call thee to go,
The rivers of sorrow shall not overflow,
For I will be with thee and thy trials to bless,
And sanctify to thee, thy deepest distress.
When through fiery trials, thy pathway shall lie,
My grace, all-sufficient, shall be thy supply,
The flame shall not hurt thee: I only design,
Thy dross to consume, and thy gold to refine.
E'en down to old age all My people shall prove,
My sovereign, eternal, unchangeable love,
And then, when grey hairs shall their temples adorn,
Like lambs they shall still in My bosom, be borne.
The soul that on Jesus hath leaned for repose,
I will not, I will not, desert to its foes,
That soul though all hell should endeavour to shake
I'll never, no never, no never forsake!
The fullness of the Godhead,
Bodily dwelleth in my Lord. (3x)
And we are complete in Him.
Complete (2x) complete in Him,
We are complete in Him (2x).
It's not by works of righteousness,
But by His grace alone (3x)
And we are complete in Him.
There's nothing more that I can do,
For Jesus did it all. (3x)
And we are complete in Him.
Father, I adore You,
Lay my life before You,
How I love You!
Jesus, I adore You,
Lay my life before You,
How I love You!
Spi-rit, I adore You,
Lay my life before You,
How I love You!

hymns.title: The Kingdom of God
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie B. Composed by Henriette M. Youth Camp 2019, 23th July 2019.

lines: The kingdom of God is not food and drink (2x)
But righteousness and peace and joy (2x)
In the Holy Ghost. (2x)
Whoever wants the life of God in him (2x)
The Holy Spirit, a pu-re heart (2x)
Must then receive as a little child. (2x)
Whatever comes from the Lord, we receive (2x)
With abundant joy, we accept by faith (2x)
Just like the children. (2x)
Thus says the Lord about the chi-ldren (2x)
Even the children are pro-files (2x)
Let's imitate them. (2x)
Oh, let us believe like the children do (2x)
And then receive that which comes from God (2x)
Just like the children. (2x)

hymns.title: 1 Corinthians 1: 27-28
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo. Youth Camp 2019, 24th July 2019. (Tune: Would you be free from your burden of sin?)

lines: (1 Corinthians 1: 27)
The foolish things of the world God did choose.
To confound the wise (2x)
God also chose the weak things of the world,
To confound the mighty and strong.
This is God's ge-neral principle,
To use that which is weak,
This is God's prin-ciple of the cross
Using us though we are weak and frail.
(1 Corinthians 1: 28)
The lowly things of the world God did choose,
Also the despised (2x)
He chose the things that are not, so as to
Nulli-fy the things which exist.
God has chosen the children as profiles,
In praise and in faith (2x)
He has indeed made the children profiles
Even in spiri-tual battles.
(Psalm 8:3)
From the lips of children and the infants,
You have ordained praise (2X)
Be-cause of Your enemies, O Lord,
To silence the avenger and foe
I'm a Wea-pon of God for warfare.
I'm of va-lue to God.
God will use the praises from my lips,
To conquer satan, our enemy.
(Psalm 8: 3)
God delights in the praise of the kids,
They serve as a tool, used by the Lord,
They are weapons for the battles of God
Through them, vic-to-ry is secured.

hymns.title: Oh Yes! For You!
hymns.author: World University of Prayer and Fasting, Koume, 5th February 2019.

lines: Oh yes! for you!
For the Master, and for the lost,
We serve those for whom the Saviour died.
We are gathered in Jesus' name,
To commit ourselves,
To preach the gospel to all men on earth
That's the reason we're here on earth.
The Lord Jesus Christ has given to us
The great commission,
Go into all the world, go and preach!
Preach the good news to all on earth.
The seductions of the world abound
To charm and distract,
The world's nothing except vanity
The true Treasure is Jesus Christ.
Go as far as the curse may be found
The curse on all men,
We'll go! Jesus commands us to go,
For He died to save each one of them.

hymns.title: My Shepherd Is the Lord
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: (Psalm 23)
My Shepherd, is the Lord
And I'll never be in ne-ed,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
He makes me to lie down
In fields full of green grass,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
Hallelujah! Your goodness and Your mer-cy
Shall follow me all the days
Of my life,
I will dwell in the house of the Lord
Till the end of my days
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
He goes right ahead of me
leading me to quiet pools,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
And He restores my soul
Keeps my feet on righteous paths,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
When danger comes my way
You are there to handle it,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
For Your rod and Your staff
Comfort and reassure me,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
He lays a table for me
In the presence of my foes,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
With His oil, He anoints my head
And my cup overflows,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
You're my Protector
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
You are my Shepherd,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
You're my Hiding place,
Amen, amen, hallelujah!
Jesus is ou-r heavenly friend,
Oh, what a love!
More than a tender friend He loves us,
Oh, what a love!
Here parents, friends and all will pass away,
Great moments do come and pass away,
But His heart, never fails to love us,
Oh, what a love!
Jesus is to us, eter-nal life,
Oh, what a love!
Let's celebrate His im-mortal work,
Oh, what a love!
Far from God He saw us wandering,
In His blood, He washed and cleansed us,
He has brought us bright in His sheepfold,
Oh, what a love!
Come to us and grant true knowledge,
Of all Your love!
And in our hearts, descend and pour in,
All of Your love!
Then let our lives be full of Your love,
May our souls be filled with wonder,
Relishing everlasting jo-y,
Oh, in Your love!

hymns.title: Oh My Heart Rejoice in Jehovah Jireh
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: Oh, my heart rejoice,
In Jehovah Jireh,
Sing of His goodness,
His grace and of His love.
He's given you Jesus
Be glad, rejoice in Him
He is your faithful friend
Your refuge and your shield.
His mercy shown to you,
Each a-nd every day,
When you are in distress,
Call Him, He'll answer you.
Oh, sing unto the Lord.
Sing of his gre-at name,
Fulfill your vows to Him
Every day, every time.
He is the King of kings,
He is the Lord of lords.
He's the Lord Almighty,
His name is wonderful.
Come, come and listen,
I want to testify,
of His good works to me,
For the Lord is my God.

hymns.title: I Have Another Home
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: I have another home on high, on high,
I have another home on high.
My Saviour has gone
To prepare me a place
I have another home above.
The Lord Jesus told us
When all will be finished
I'll come back to take you with Me.
The Lord is preparing,
A home for every saint,
Where He will receive us on high.
All will be well designed
And very beautiful
In my brand-new home above.
All the good finishings
And every perfection
Will be in my new home on high.
No eye has ever seen
This type of home before
That Christ is preparing for us.
Magnificent homes on earth,
Are worse than all shantys
When compared to our homes on high.

hymns.title: Shout Unto the Lord
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: Shout unto the Lord: oh! oh! oh!
With your loudest voice: oh! oh! oh!
All the beautiful songs
And our entire lives,
We bring to You Lord
You are our love.
All my days and nights
Belong to you Lord
My entire life
I surrender all to You
From my heart
I will live for You.
I will raise up high
My cup of deliverance
Lord I'll praise your name
You've taken me from
The deepest pit my Lord
Glory to your name.
I'll be in heaven,
No, not by my works
But Lord, by your blood
you'll wipe away
All the tears of my life.
oh. may this day come.

hymns.title: Glory, the Lord Is Risen
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: Glo-ry Jesus is risen. Ah! Jesus 's alive,
And we bring you good news,
Ah! glory to God, the Most High.
Jesus has co-nquered death.
Glory, God has raised Jesus,
Ah! He was rescued from the chains of de-ath.
Ah! Christ is stronger than satan,
He lived on earth without sin.
Glory, He has conquered death,
Ah! He is my victory I shall never fear,
Ah! My saviour, is Almighty,
To be with Him forever.
Glory! Jesus is my life,
Ah! He lives in me and so, I live for Him,
Ah! He'll come back to take me soon,
To be with Him forever.
Christ is calling you today,
Come! Repent! Do not harden your heart,
Then when He comes back for His sheep.
You will be taken along.

hymns.title: He Is King, He Is King
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: He is king, He is king,
And He is Lord of lords,
Oh, let all the earth,
Celebrate in His name,
He is king. Jesus Christ is King.
He is seated on the throne and He reigns
Interceding for all of the saints
Oh, let all the earth,
Celebrate in His name,
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
God has raised Him in the heavenly places
Above every principality,
Oh, let all the earth,
Celebrate in His name,
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
In His name we cast out all demons
And in His name, we heal the sick
Oh, let all the earth,
Celebrate in His name,
He is King, Jesus Christ is King.
And can it be that I should gain,
An interest in the Saviour's blood?
Died He for me, who caused His pain,
For me, who Him to death pursued?
Amazing love! How can it be,
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?
Amazing love! How can it be,
That Thou, my God, shouldst die for me?
'Tis mystery all! The Immortal dies
Who can explore His strange design?
In vain the firstborn seraph tries
To sound the depths of love divine,
'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore,
Let angel minds inquire no more.
'Tis mercy all! Let earth adore;
Let angel minds inquire no more.
He left His Father's throne above
so free, so infinite His grace
Emptied Himself of all but love,
And bled for Adam's helpless race
'Tis mercy all, immense and free.
For O my God, it found out me!
'Tis mercy all, immense and free.
For O my God, it found out me!
Long my imprisoned spirit lay,
Fast bound in sin and nature's night;
Thine eye diffused a quickening ray
I woke, the dungeon flamed with light;
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth, and followed Thee.
My chains fell off, my heart was free,
I rose, went forth, and followed Thee.
No condemnation now I dread;
Jesus, and all in Him, is mine;
Alive in Him, my living Head,
And clothed in righteousness divine,
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.
Bold I approach the eternal throne,
And claim the crown, through Christ my own.

hymns.title: I Am a Fanatic of Jesus
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: I am a fanatic of Jesus
I'm not ashamed to sho-w it forth
His mighty hand has transformed my life
And in him, I am fulfilled.
Ah! Lord Jesus
Lord Jesus
My Lord Jesus
Ah! Lord Jesus
How your love has conquered my heart!
How I wondered day and night
Under the weight of my sins
But when Your light shone upon my life
Your forgiveness cleansed all my sins.
I was always sad and low
Down-cast by many cares
But when Your light shone upon my life
Your love filled my heart with much joy
Weighed down by suf-fering
Through much sickness and pain
But when Your light shone upon my life
Your power healed me completely.
Disappointments came my way
Yes, I failed many times
But when Your light shone upon my life
I became a success for God.

hymns.title: Jesus, We Give You Praise
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo.

lines: Jesus, we praise Your name,
Emmanuel, we ce-le-brate You,
The Bright morning star, the Lion of Judah,
You're victorious for eternity,
The Bright morning star, the Lion of Judah,
Yes, in Your name, every knee must bow.
All of us had gone astray,
Like sheep without no shepherd,
Each one of us followed his own way,
Your call of love reached out to us
Then we responded to this great love O Lord,
You set us free by the pow'r of Your Name.
We are more than conquerors,
Through You Lord who gives us strength,
We have the hope eter-nal life.
For we believe in Your name,
We have the hope of eternal life
For we believe in Your name, O Lord.
In Your name, O Lord Jesus,
All sinners find salvation,
All demons are cast out,
All sicknesses are healed,
Hope is reborn in our lives,
All demons are cast out,
All the s-ick a-re healed,
Hope is reborn in our lives, O Lord.

hymns.title: Proclamations
hymns.author: Translated by Anna Donald. World University of Prayer and Fasting for the Ministers of Praise. Koume, 4th September 2016.

lines: At the name of Jesus,
E-ve-ry knee must bow,
E-ve-ry tongue must confess,
That Jesus Christ is Lord,
That Jesus Christ is Lord!
(Matthew 28: 18-20)
O-ur Lord Jesus said:
A-ll authority,
In heaven and in earth,
Has been given to Me
So, go and make disciples
In e-ve-ry nation,
For I will be with you,
To the end of the age.
(Colossians 2: 15)
Jesus Christ overcame
The devil on the cross,
Jesus Christ has disarmed
Principalities and po-wers,
Jesus Christ made of them
A public spec-ta-cle,
He triumphed over them
By His death on the cross.
At the name of Jesus
All the saints must proclaim.
In the name of Jesus,
We will bring all our praise.
In the name of Jesus,
We'll be blessed with results,
In the name of Jesus,
The plunder will be ours.
At the name of Jesus
All the saints must proclaim.
In the name of Jesus,
We will bring all our praise
In the name of Jesus,
We'll be blessed with results,
In the name of Jesus,
We will conquer the world.

hymns.title: Immortal, Invisible, God Only Wise
hymns.author: Walter Chalmers Smith, 1824-1906.

lines: Immortal, invisible, God only wise,
In light inaccessible hid from our eyes,
Most blessed, most glorious, the Ancient of days,
Almighty, victorious, Thy great name we praise.
Unresting, unhasting, and silent as light
Nor wanting, nor wasting, Thou rulest in might;
Thy justice like mountains high soaring above
Thy clouds which are fountains of goodness and love
To all, life Thou givest, to both great and small;
In all life Thou livest, the true life of all;
We blossom and flourish as leaves on the tree,
And wither and perish but nought changeth Thee.
Great Father of glory, pure Father of light,
Thine angels adore Thee, all veiling their sight;
All laud we would render: O help us to see
'Tis only the splendour of light hidest Thee.
Jerusalem, my happy home!
Name ever dear to me:
When shall my labours have an end.
In joy, and peace, and thee?
When shall these eyes thy heaven-built walls
And pearly gates behold?
Thy bulwarks, with salvation strong,
And streets of shining gold?
There happier flowers than Eden's bloom,
Nor sin nor sorrow know:
Blest seats, through rude and stormy scenes,
onward press to you.
Why should I shrink at pain and woe?
Or feel at death dismay?
I've Canaan's goodly land in view,
And realms of endless day.
Apostles, martyrs, prophets there
Around my Saviour stand;
And soon my friends in Christ below
Will join the glorious band.
Jerusalem, my happy home!
My soul still pants for thee;
Then shall my labours have an end,
When I thy joys shall see.
Christ do Thou my soul prepare
For that bright home of love;
That I may see Thee and adore,
With all Thy saints above.

hymns.title: Through the Love of God Our Saviour

lines: Through the love of God our Saviour,
All will be well;
Free and changeless is His favour;
All, all is well.
Precious is the blood that healed us;
Perfect is the grace that sealed us;
Strong the hand stretched out to shield us;
All must be well.
Though we pass through tribulation,
All will be well;
Ours is such a full salvation;
All, all is well.
Happy still in God confiding,
Fruitful, if in Christ abiding,
Holy through the Spirit's guiding,
All must be well.
We expect a bright tomorrow;
All will be well;
Faith can sing through days of sorrow,
All, all is well.
On our Father's love relying,
Jesus every need supplying,
Or in living, or in dying,
All must be well.
Lord, I hear of showers of blessing,
Thou art scattering, full and free;
Showers, the thirsty land refreshing
Let some drops descend on me;
Even me, even me,
Let some drops descend on me.
Pass me not, O gracious Father,
Sinful though my heart may be!
Thou mightst leave me, but the rather;
Let Thy mercy light on me;
Even me, even me,
Let Thy mercy light on me.
Pass me not, O tender Saviour,
Let me love and cling to Thee;
I am longing for Thy favour:
When Thou comest, call for me:
Even me, even me,
Whilst Thou'rt calling, oh, call me.
Pass me not, O mighty Spirit!
Thou canst make the blind to see:
Witnesser of Jesus' merit,
Speak the word of power to me:
Even me, even me,
Speak the word of power to me.
Have I been in sin long sleeping,
Long been slighting, grieving Thee?
Has the world my heart been keeping?
Oh, forgive and rescue me;
Even me, even me,
Oh, forgive and rescue me.
Love of God, so pure and changeless,
Blood of Christ, so rich and free;
Grace of God, so strong and boundless
Magnify them all in me;
Even me, even me,
Magnify them all in me.
Pass me not; but pardon bringing,
Bind my heart, O Lord, to Thee;
Whilst the streams of life are springing,
Blessing others, oh, bless me;
Even me, even me,
Blessing others, oh, bless me.

hymns.title: I've a Message from the Lord

lines: I've a message from the Lord, hallelujah!
The message unto you I'll give;
'Tis recorded in His Word, hallelujah!
It is only that you "look and live".
"look and live. my brother, live!...
look to Jesus now and live:
'Tis recorded in His Word, hallelujah!
It's only that you "look and live!"
I've a message full of love, hallelujah!
A message, oh, my friend
'Tis a message from above, hallelujah!
Jesus said it and I know 'tis true.
Life is offered unto thee, hallelujah!
Eternal life thy soul shall have,
If you'll only look to Him, hallelujah!
Look to Jesus who alone can save.
I will tell you how I came, hallelujah!
To Jesus, when He made me whole;
'Twas believing on His name, hallelujah!
I trusted and He saved my soul.

hymns.title: Standing on the Promises of Christ

lines: Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring,
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.
Standing, standing,
Standing on the promises of God my Saviour;
Stand-ing..., stand-ing...,
I'm standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living word of God shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord,
Bound to Him eternally by love's strong cord,
Overcoming daily with the Spirit's sword,
Standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises I cannot fall,
Listening every moment to the Spirit's call
Resting in my Saviour as my all in all.
standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises I now can see
Perfect, present cleansing in the blood for me;
Standing in the liberty where Christ makes free,
Standing on the promises of God,

hymns.title: Hallelujah, Praise Our God
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: I am God's own handiwork,
I am unique, one of its kind,
To accomplish the works that,
He had planned, I am unique, I am special!
Hallelujah! praise our God,
In whose image I'm created,
I'm a marvel for You made me,
Hallelujah, hallelujah!
He has saved me, I am His.
He is moulding and chipping me,
Every day to be like Jesus Christ,
Nothing in me is by error.
I am weak but He is strong,
He dwells in me, my strength is Him,
His grace is all sufficient for my life,
In Jesus Christ, the weak are strong.
Brother, I am not like you,
Sister, I cannot replace you,
Though so different, God loves each one of us,
And in Him there's true harmony.

hymns.title: Jesus Is in Our Midst Today

lines: Jesus is in our midst today,
His tender, loving eyes're on us.
Oh, hear His warm and tender voice,
I want to bless you all. (2x)
Jesus is in our midst today,
His tender, loving eyes're on us.
Oh, hear His warm and tender voice,
I'm here to set you free. (2x)
Jesus is in our midst today,
His tender, loving eyes're on us.
Oh, hear His warm and tender voice,
I love each one of you. (2x)

hymns.title: Mine Eyes Have Seen the Glory

lines: Mine eyes have seen the glory,
Of the coming of the Lord;
He is trampling out the vintage,
Where the grapes of wrath are stored;
He hath loosed the fateful lightning
Of His terrible swift sword;
His truth is marching on.
Glory, glory! Hallelujah! (3x)
His truth is marching on.
He has sounded forth the trumpet
That shall never call retreat;
He is sifting out the hearts of men
Before His judgment seat;
Oh, be swift, my soul, to answer Him;
Be jubilant, my feet!
Our God is marching on.
In the beauty of the lilies
Christ was born across the sea,
With a glory in His bosom
That transfigures you and me:
As He died to make men holy,
let us live to make men free,
While God is marching on.
He is coming like the glory,
Of the morning on the wave,
He is wisdom to the mighty,
He is succour to the brave;
So the world shall be His footstool,
And the soul of time His slave,
Our God is marching on.

hymns.author: Julia Ward Howe, 1819-1910.

lines: Christian! seek not yet repose;
Cast thy dreams of ease away,
Thou art in the midst of foes:
"Watch and pray".
Principalities and powers,
Mustering their unseen array,
Wait for thy unguarded hours:
"Watch and pray".
Gird thy heavenly armour on,
Wear it every night and day,
Ambushed lies the evil one:
"Watch and pray".
Hear the victors who o'ercame;
Still they mark each warrior's way;
All with one clear voice exclaim:
"Watch and pray".
Hear, above all, hear thy Lord,
Him thou lovest to obey;
Hide within thy heart His word,
"Watch and pray".
Watch, as if on that alone
Hung the issue of the day;
Pray that help may be sent down:
"Watch and pray".

hymns.title: Look, Ye Saints, the Sight Is Glorious

lines: Look, ye saints, the sight is glorious:
See the "Man of Sorrows" now;
From the fight return victorious,
Every knee to Him shall bow!
Crown Him! crown Him! Angels, crown Him!
Crown the saviour "King of kings!"
Crown the Saviour! angels, crown Him;
Rich the trophies Jesus brings;
In the seat of power enthrone Him,
While the vault of heaven rings.
Sinners in derision scorned Him,
Mocking thus the Saviour's claim;
Saints and angels crowd around Him,
Own His title, praise His name.
Hark, the bursts of acclamation!
Hark, those loud triumphant chords!
Jesus takes the highest station;
Oh, what joy the sight affords!
More holiness give me,
More strivings within.
More patience in suffering,
More sorrow for sin.
More faith in my Saviour,
More sense of His care.
More joy in His service,
More purpose in prayer.
More gratitude give me,
More trust in the Lord.
More zeal for His glory,
More hope in His word.
More tears for His sorrows,
More pain at His grief
More meekness in trial,
More praise for relief.
More purity give me,
More strength to o'ercome,
More freedom from earth-stains,
More longings for home.
More fit for the kingdom,
More useful would I be,
More blessed and holy,
More, Saviour, like Thee.

hymns.title: Oh Come, Oh Come Immanuel
hymns.author: From Antiphons in Latin Breviary, 12th cent., Tr. by John Mason Neale, 1818-1866.

lines: Oh come, oh come Immanuel,
And ransom captive Israel,
That mourns in lonely exile here
Until the Son of God appears.
Rejoice! rejoice! Immanuel,
Shall come to Thee, O Israel.
Oh come, thou Rod of Jesse, free
Thine own from Satan's tyranny;
From depths of hell thy people save,
And give them victory o'er the grave.
Oh come, thou day-spring, come and cheer
Our spirits by thine advent here;
Disperse the gloomy clouds of night,
And death's dark shadows put to flight.
Oh come, thou key of David, come,
And open wide our heavenly home;
Make safe the way that leads on high,
And close the path to misery.
Tell me the old, old story
Of unseen things above,
Of Jesus and His glory,
Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story simply,
As to a little child,
For I am weak and weary,
And helpless and defiled.
Tell me the old, old story
Tell me the old, old story
Tell me the old, old story,
Of Jesus and His love.
Tell me the story slowly,
That I may take it in,
That wonderful redemption,
God's remedy for sin.
Tell me the story often,
For I forget so soon;
The early dew of morning
Has passed away at noon.
Tell me the story softly,
With earnest tones and grave;
Remember! I'm the sinner
Whom Jesus came to save.
Tell me the story always,
If you would really be,
In any time of trouble,
A comforter to me.
Tell me the same old story
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Is costing me too dear.
yes. and when that world's glory
Is dawning on my soul,
Tell me the old, old story:
Christ Jesus makes thee whole.

hymns.title: There's a Land That Is Fair

lines: There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar;
For the Father waits over the way
To prepare us a dwelling place there.
In the sweet... by and by...
We shall meet on that beautiful shore;
In the sweet... by and by...
We shall meet on that beautiful shore.
We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blest;
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest.
To our bountiful Father above
We will offer our tribute of praise,
For the glorious gift of His love,
And the blessings that hallow our days.

hymns.title: Jehovah Jireh
hymns.author: Translated by Macrine Nyisomeh.

lines: Jehovah Jireh, God our Provider,
With Your blessings, You've lavished us,
And we live in You without regret,
We want to cry out! God You are the King,
You alone are worthy to be praised,
From now throughout eternity.
When you have cause to fear
That this world's empty glory
Jesus, our Lord! How wonderful You are!
From pole to pole, You have stretched out Your gracious hand,
To protect all Your children but that is not all,
You answer when they call, You meet their needs,
You do this for those who belong to You,
To who You are worth more than money.
How vast, and great, O Lord is Your majesty
Your creation, displays Your great po-wer
Ears have not heard about a God like Yah-weh
In wealth and riches You surpass them al-l.
The heavens and the earth belong to You.
Who can compare to You, O my God?
When hard times come, along this pilgrim way
In You O Lord, we find shelter and re-fuge
From genera-tion to genera-tion,
The saints testify of Your faithfulness,
Lord, You have truly satisfied our hearts.
We put all o-ur hope in You, O my God!

hymns.title: Onward Ever
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: Onward ever, without lingering
To the home on high.
Forward marching, pressing onward
To obtain the price.
I'm a child of God Most High,
He's my Shield and my Defence
Moving forward without doubting,
To the Father's home.
At the throne are crowns of glory,
The victor's reward.
Strengthen weak knees, onward ever!
Is our Lord's command.
Love the Lord, obey His word!
Don't be lukewarm or shrink back,
There's no place for the double minded,
At the marriage feast.
Forward ever, firm and steadfast
Press toward the goal.
God is watching, may He keep me,
From entanglement.
Let the world and all its charm,
Never have a hold on me.
Yes, it hates me, 'cause it hates Him!
So I am at peace.
God of all grace, tender Father,
Hold me by the hand,
Be my stronghold and my Refuge,
Thou the Lord of Hosts.
God Almighty! That's Your name.
Surely You can make me stand,
And my victory brings You glory,
Oh my God and King.

hymns.title: Lord Open My Eyes
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo. Student Camp, 2019, 7th August 2019.

lines: Oh my Lord, I pray, reveal to me,
Your great love for all mankind,
So therefore I'll see in every man,
A person sought by the Lord.
Oh, dear Lord, I pray, open my eyes,
That everyone I will meet,
Is the reason why You gave Your life,
And shed your blood on the cross.
Oh, dear Lord, Oh, dear Lord,
Open my eyes that I may see,
The value, the value,
Of your death, Lord, on the cross.
Lord please help me to preach the gospel,
To everyone I will meet,
Lord that your blood would not have been shed,
Oh, shed in vain for mankind.
Grant to me, Lord, a revelation.
Of the Holy Spirit's work,
In this world after the departure,
Of Jesus Christ o-ur Lord.
Oh Lord, I plead reveal to me,
The mission of the Holy Ghost,
He who convicts men of their sin,
Of righteousness and judgement.
Oh Lord, please reveal to me the pow'r,
Of the gospel of the Lord,
So that it won't be buried in me,
But that I'll preach to the lost.
Oh, renew the burden Lord, in me,
To preach the gospel of Christ,
To the members of my family,
So that they will all be saved.
Reveal to me the re-ality,
And the dura-tion of hell,
And the torment for those that perish,
Those who die without the Lord.
My burdens, my pre-occupations,
Are of no use and so vain,
Oh, they reveal the passing nature,
Of the world and all its lust.
Lord reveal to me the duration,
And vastness of eternity,
Make e-ter-nity a reality,
And may my choices reveal.
May every opportunity, Lord,
To act and serve for thy use,
Be received then as a privilege,
Plead-ing to serve You my Lord.
Oh Lord, please help me to be caught up,
With things that are from above,
Reveal to me the re-ality,
And the great bliss of heaven,
Sowing in the morning,
Sowing seeds of kindness,
Sowing in the noontide
And the dewy eves:
Waiting for the harvest,
And the time of reaping,
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves!
Bringing in the sheaves!
Bringing in the sheaves!
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves!
Sowing in the sunshine,
Sowing in the shadows,
Fearing neither clouds nor
Winter's chilling breeze;
By and by the harvest,
And the labour ended,
We shall come rejoicing,
Bringing in the sheaves!
Go then ever, weeping,
Sowing for the Master,
Though the loss sustained
Our spirit often grieves:
When our weeping's over,
He will bid us welcome,
We shall come rejoicing
Bringing in the sheaves!

hymns.title: The Lord Is My Salvation
hymns.author: Translated by Winnie Belombo. 10th January 2019.

lines: I'll sing of Your salvation
Together with the brethren
And I will sing of your love, forever.
(Psalm 27: 1)
The Lord is my salvation
He's the light of my life
I will praise Him till the end of my days.
(Exodus 15: 2)
Oh Yes, the Lord is my strength
He's the reason why I sing
He has become my salva-tion.
(Psalm 62: 7)
'Tis the Lord who is my rock
My salvation and my refuge
I will praise Him, praise His name every day.
(Isaiah 12: 2)
Surely God is my salvation
He's become my salvation
I'll proclaim His name wherever I go.
(Psalm 89: 26)
O...h God, You are my Father,
O...h God, You are my God,
Yes, You are my rock and my Sa-viour.
(Psalm 94: 22)
The Lord has become my fortress,
He has become my rock,
He is My God, in Him I find refuge.
(Psalm 19:7, Psalm 119: 105).
O How beautiful is the Word!
You've given us O Lord
A lamp unto o-ur
And a light for our path
And when we read Your Word, O Lord
It makes our hearts rejoice
For it makes the simple wise,
And brings the fear of God.
Oh yes, Your Word, oh my Lord,
Is a great treasure
I've hidden it in my heart
It is my delight.
(Genesis 22: 14).
O Lord, I've seen Your provision,
And I have all I need.
For You are Jehovah Jireh
The Lord our provider
For the needs of all Your children
And for the ministry,
You give exceedingly above all
We could ask or think.
You are so good, O Father
And so generous
You are faithful and in You
Our souls are at rest.
(Revelation 21: 27).
You have written my name, O Lord,
In... the Book of life
And I walk in holiness on earth,
For I will soon see You,
You are coming back soon to take me,
To be with You, O God
And I'll walk on the beautiful streets in the ci-ty of gold.
My future is guaranteed.
In You O Lord
You are faithful and in You
My soul is at rest.

hymns.title: What a Friend We Have in Jesus

lines: What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful?
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness,
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
Are we weak and heavy-laden?
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Saviour, still our refuge,
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer;
In His arms He'll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.

hymns.title: What a Faithful Friend Is Jesus
hymns.author: Translated WUPF.

lines: What a faithful friend is Jesus,
When we love and obey Him
He's attentive and He hears us:
And He answers when we call.
Of our weakness He's no stranger,
Or our failures of each day,
He is holy and He's awesome,
But is tender in His love.
What a faithful friend is Jesus,
When we love and obey Him,
Full of sympathy and mercy,
When we're crushed with woes and cares.
Bring to Him your fears and worries,
From your heart speak to the Lord,
He will send His word with healing,
And our cares will fly away.
What a faithful friend is Jesus,
When we love and obey Him,
Always present, our Defender
When the devil presses hard.
At all moments He is near us,
In His arms we are secure,
He's the captain of God's army,
And with Him victory is sure.
What a faithful friend is Jesus,
When we love and obey Him,
Always there to teach and help us,
To count only on His strength.
If he sees us true and sincere,
In our search of holiness,
Then be sure He'll hear our pra-yers
And will give us peace and joy.
What a faithful friend is Jesus,
When we love and obey Him
Soon He's coming back to take us,
To His home for evermore.
Let us run the race before us,
Counting always on His help,
Soon and very soon He'll take us,
To be with Him evermore.

hymns.title: All People That on Earth Do Dwell
hymns.author: William Kethe D. 1593.

lines: (Psalm 100)
All people that on earth do dwell,
Sing to the Lord with cheerful voice.
Him serve with mirth, His praise forth tell.
Come ye before Him and rejoice.
Know that the Lord is God indeed;
Without our aid He did us make;
We are His flock, He doth us feed;
And for His sheep He doth us take.
Oh, enter then His gates with praise;
Approach with joy His courts unto;
Praise, laud, and bless His name always,
For it is seemly so to do.
For why? The Lord our God is good;
His mercy is for ever sure;
His truth at all times firmly stood,
And shall from age to age endure.

hymns.title: Jesus of Nazareth
hymns.author: (Tune: "Pass me not, O gentle Saviour")

lines: Jesus of Nazareth went about
Healing those oppressed,
The possessed and sick came running,
Crying out to Him.
Saviour, Master!
All my hopes in You
Lay Your healing hand upon me,
O Lord, set me free.
"Be it done to You" said Jesus
As you have believed,
His word brought them deep assurance
Banished all their fears.
In compassion Jesus touched them
Where their ailment was,
With His touch diseases took flight,
They were all made whole.
P'wer to heal is always with Him
Power to make each whole,
He's today just as He was then,
Jesus is here to heal.

hymns.title: At the Name of Jesus

lines: At the name of Jesus!
Every knee has to bow
Every tongue should confess
That Jesus Christ is Lord. (2x)
Jesus is God the Son
But made of Himself nothing
Taking on human form
Became a bond servant
Jesus humbled Himself
In all things he obeyed
Obedient unto death
E'en the death on the cross!
Therefore, God the Father
Has highly exalted Him
Far above everything
And gi-ven Him the Name
Name above every name
That at Jesus' name
Every knee has to bow
In heaven and on the earth.
At the name of Jesus
We breakthrough all strongholds
At the name of Jesus
We knock down all barriers
At the name of Jesus
We take every thought captive
At the name of Jesus
We bring salvation to men!

hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: Absolute surrender is a transaction,
That a person makes with God,
Handing over all his future,
To Jesus and make Him, Lord.
He surrenders all (2x)
Then he takes his cross to follow,
Jesus Christ the Lord.
His ambitions and desires
He puts an end to them all
Yes, his loves and all his pleasures
Submitting them to the Lord.
Total surrender means also
Letting go expectations
From your father, from your mother
And your entourage as well,
Give your all to Him (2x)
Then take up your cross and follow Jesus Christ the Lord.
Your surrender must be total
From this day and forever
Accepting to be poor
that is His will for you,
Without absolute surrender
None will know the call of God
Those who know total surrender
Are useful unto the Lord.
Will you give your all? (2x)
Carry your cross and come follow Jesus Christ our Lord?

hymns.title: You Are So Great
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: You are so great Jesus, You are so good,
You are so great and You are so good,
Greater than we imagine,
Greater than my tongue can tell,
On this earth,
There is none else like You, O Lord!
How I need words to proclaim;
Your righteousness and Your greatness,
Your majesty and Your splendour!
O Lord, You are so great,
I am confused within me,
How to celebrate Your compassion,
Then Your love and Your mercy,
O Lord, You are so good.
On the cross of calvary,
You bore all our transgressions.
Our sins, humiliations!
O Lord, You are so good.
On the cross You were a curse,
And we inherit Your blessings,
And You freed us from bondage,
O Lord, You are so good!
To many blind men You gave sight,
And You healed, many of diseases,
You opened the ears of the deaf,
O Lord, You are so great.
You spoke and calmed the tempest,
And You walked upon the water,
When I consider Your work,
O Lord, You are so great.

hymns.title: Thrice Holy God
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF. (Tune: "I've reached the land of corn and wine")

lines: "Thrice holy God, the Lord Most High"
The anthem of the heavenly host
Unending song by day and night
Thrice holy God, the Lord Most High (2x)
Unceasing anthem of His hosts.
Prayer is to be preoccupied,
With the holiness of our God,
So Jesus taught His disciples,
"Our Father, hallow be Thy Name".
In prayer we also celebrate,
The holiness of God Most High,
It is to exalt and proclaim,
And to impose His holiness.
The key to pray'r is holiness,
If you would come to God in truth,
All who love sin must keep away,
For such do come to woo His wrath.
Reveal Your holiness to me
I want to draw near in pray',
So I will sanctify myself,
With repentance, then fast and pray.
Prayer is first intimacy,
With the God of all holiness,
So while on earth I must proclaim,
Through my prayer His holiness.
O Lord, I plead reveal to me,
What sin does to the heart of God,
Then I can truly turn from it,
Henceforth I really want to pray.

hymns.title: For God So Loved This Sinful World

lines: For God so loved this sinful world
That He gave His Begotten Son
That whoever believes in Him
Should not perish. (3x)
Out of deep love You call us now
To give to You our fleeting wealth
That we may gain eternal wealth
Oh, our God. (3x)
Give and it will be given to you
God will ensure that you receive
A good measure pressed down, shaken,
And running o'er. (3x)
My child give Me your heart this day
That My glory may dwell in there,
I want your heart to be My throne
For ever more. (3x)
My Lord I come to You this day
To lay my life at Your feet, Lord
Oh, take my heart and make it Thine
Yes, Thine alone. (3x)
Like the saints in Macedonia
Who were in extreme poverty
But with th' abundance of true joy
We'll give to You. (3x)
All selfishness, I now renounce
With generosity I'll give
And far beyond my ability
Freely I'll give. (3x)
I won't be coaxed, or be threatened
For me to give to You my Lord
But freely, willing I will beg
I'll give to You. (3x)
Forgive my blindness of the past
When I gave with such nonchalance
Henceforth I'll plead to give to You
With urgency. (3x)

hymns.title: The Only King Who Rules
hymns.author: Translated WUPF.

lines: The only King who rules o'er the earth
The only One who rules in heaven
The One King over the universe
This sovereign King is Jesus Christ.
He is the One who must be sang
The only One to be acclaimed
The only One who's to be adored
The One who is worthy is Jesus Christ.
The One who does set free from sin
The One who breaks the chains that bind
The One who sets the prisoners free
The Liberator is Jesus Christ.
He is the Victor over death
He is the Victor o'er satan
He is the One who conquered for me
The victorious One is Jesus Christ.
Hallelujah to You, O Lord
Hallelujah to the King of kings
Hallelujah to the Lion of Judah
Hallelujah to Jesus Christ.
Yield not to temptation,
For yielding is sin,
Each victory will help you
Some other to win;
Fight manfully onward,
Dark passions subdue.
Look ever to Jesus,
He'll carry you through.
Ask the Saviour to help you,
Comfort, strengthen, and keep you
He is willing to aid you,
He will carry you through.
Shun evil companions,
Bad language disdain,
God's name hold in reverence,
Nor take it in vain:
Be thoughtful and earnest,
Kind-hearted and true;
Look ever to Jesus,
He'll carry you through.
To him that o'ercometh
God giveth a crown;
Through faith we shall conquer,
Though rarely cast down;
He who is our Saviour
Our strength will renew;
Look ever to Jesus,
He'll carry you through.

hymns.title: Rejoice Always
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: Rejoice always, in the Lord Jesus, rejoice
Rejoice! you have Jesus Christ as Saviour
Oh yes rejoice, when all speak evil of you
Your joy is a weapon against the foe
Be not afraid of satan's legions
Sing and exult as we march on
We're more than conquerors on this earth
So then rejoice, always rejoice!
Rejoice again, when the battle is raging
We are enlisted for life in the fight
As soldiers, we have chosen to please Jesus
We'll never betray the Lord nor the cross
Let none of us deny our Captain!
He is our Lord and glorious King!
For Him we despise shame and mockery
So then rejoice, again rejoice!
Rejoice again! For soon before the angels,
Jesus will say: these are knights! They are Mine."
With joyful hearts, our anthem then we'll blast forth
To hail Jesus our vic-to-rious King
Let's then rejoice to suffer for Him,
For by His help we'll overcome,
Because He loves us we are steadfast
With joyful hearts we sing, "Rejoice !"
I am thine, O Lord,
I have heard Thy voice
And it told Thy love to me;
But I long to rise
In the arms of faith,
And be closer drawn to Thee.
Draw me nearer...er
Nearer, blessed Lord.
To the cross where Thou hast died;
Draw me nearer..., nearer blessed Lord,
To Thy precious, bleeding side.
Consecrate me now
To Thy service, Lord
By the power of grace Divine;
Let my soul look up
With a steadfast hope,
And my will be lost in Thine.
Oh, the pure delight
Of a single hour
That before Thy throne I spend,
When I kneel in prayer,
And with Thee, my God,
I commune as friend with friend.
There are depths of love
That I cannot know
Till I cross the narrow sea;
There are heights of joy
That I may not reach
Till I rest in peace with Thee.
Jesus, Lover of my soul,
Let me to Thy bosom fly,
While the nearer waters roll,
While the tempest still is high;
Hide me, O my Saviour, hide,
Till the storm of life is past;
Safe into the haven guide;
Oh, receive my soul at last!
Other refuge have I none;
Hangs my helpless soul on Thee;
Leave, ah, leave me not alone;
Still support and comfort me.
All my trust on Thee is stayed;
All my help from Thee I bring;
Cover my defenceless head
With the shadow of Thy wing.
Thou, O Christ, art all I want;
More than all in Thee I find;
Raise the fallen, cheer the faint,
Heal the sick, and lead the blind.
Just and holy is Thy name,
I am all unrighteousness;
False, and full of sin I am,
Thou art full of truth and grace.
Plenteous grace with Thee is found,
Grace to cover all my sin;
Let the healing streams abound;
Make and keep me pure within.
Thou of life the Fountain art,
Freely let me take of Thee;
Spring Thou up within my heart,
Rise to all eternity.

hymns.title: God Be with You Till We Meet Again
hymns.author: Jeremiah Eames Rankin, 1828-1904.

lines: God be with you till we meet again!
By His counsels, guide, uphold you,
With His sheep securely fold you;
God be with you till we meet again!
Till we meet!... Till we meet!...
Till we meet at Jesus feet; ...
Till we meet!... Till we meet! ...
God be with you till we meet again.
God be with you till we meet again!
'Neath His wings securely hide you.
Daily manna still provide you;
God be with you till we meet again!
God be with you till we meet again!
When life's perils thick confound you,
Put His loving arms round you,
God be with you till we meet again!
God be with you till we meet again!
Keep love's banner floating o'er you,
Smite death's threatening wave before you;
God be with you till we meet again!

hymns.title: Oh, Thank You God for Your Spirit
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF.

lines: Oh, thank You God, and thanks for Your Spirit
And thank You for Your Son Jesus Christ
Let's sing to God! Let's sing to our King
The One who gives us His own victory.
And You, oh my friend, why are you on this earth?
Have you thought of your Creator?
And do you know? That He's given you
A Liberator, who is Jesus?
Oh, come my friend, Oh, come to Jesus!
Right now Jesus wants to save your soul
Oh, come! Believe! Oh, come and repent
For He wants to give you His Spi-rit.
Oh, hear His tender voice down deep in your heart
Pleading 'come, oh, come my child,
Don't hesitate! Believe Jesus
And you will find life, abundant life.
Don't hesitate, but turn and believe!
The Saviour's blood, shed on the cross for you
For very soon! He'll come back again
To take to His home, those who have believed!

hymns.title: The World Convention
hymns.author: Translated by WUPF Koume, 1st September 2019.

lines: The World Convention's here at last!
The Lord had heard and answered us,
He's gathered us here today,
From one hundred five nations.
The Lord has been our faithful God,
He heard our cries to Him,
This project of His heart,
He's accomplished.
The World Convention's here at last!!
A holy convoca-tion,
It is a cele-bration,
We celebrate God's love for us.
A festival to offer thanks,
To our God, th' Eternal One,
A feast of rejoicing,
To His honour.
The World Convention's here at last!!!
For us it's a pre-sentation,
Of our entire Ministry,
To all who are part of it.
Our message and the men we have
All our ins-ti-tu-tions
All what we have in hand
For ou-r goal.
The Convention's a gathe-ring
For deep brotherly fellowship
With others share our meals
A-give-and-take occasion
We all shall receive ministry
And receive impartations
From each de-le-gation,
That is our wealth.
The World Convention's here at last!!!
It is a solemn occasion
Highlighting some profiles
Those who have distinguished themselves
By this ou-r comm-uni-ty
Will establish values
Of things that for us all
Are important.
The World Convention's here at last!
To communicate the vision,
Of our Pha-se 3,
The Rhema of God for us,
What the Santa Cruz message was
To us for our Phase 2,
The Bertoua message wi-ll
Be in Phase 3.
The World Convention's here at last!!
A time of re-commission-ing
A re-conse-cra-tion
Of all our comm-unity
Our God will re-commission us
Then we will commit ourselves
Afresh to ou-r goal
To get it done.
The World Convention's here at last!!
A time to call upon the Lord
To pray and intercede
For our entire ministry
Oh, we will pray for our vision
And pray for leaders too
Also for major things
As at PROCCL.
The World Convention will include
A planning session of our call
In concerted effort
And also orga-nisation
Touching our auxi'ry bases
The regional ones also
And strategic bases
And discipline!
How wonderful You are, O Lord!
We lift our hearts to You our God
Hearts full of gratitude
Your loving kindness celebrate
Ou-r acclamations, receive!
Our shouts and cries of joy
In heaven and on earth
There's none like You.
Come, ye sinners, poor and needy,
Weak and wounded, sick and sore;
Jesus ready stands to save you,
Full of pity, love, and power.
He is able; (2x)
He is willing: doubt no more.
Now, ye needy, come and welcome;
God's free bounty glorify:
True belief and true repentance
Every grace that brings you nigh
Without money, (2x)
Come to Jesus Christ and buy.
Let not conscience make you linger,
Nor of fitness fondly dream;
All the fitness He requireth
Is to feel your need of Him:
This He gives you (2x)
'Tis the Spirit's rising beam.
Come, ye weary, heavy-laden,
Bruised and ruined by the Fall;
If you tarry till you're better,
You will never come at all:
Not the righteous (2x)
Sinners, Jesus came to call.
View Him prostrate in the garden,
On the ground your Maker lies!
On the bloody tree behold Him,
Hear Him cry before He dies
"It is finished!" (2x)
Sinner, will not this suffice?
Lo, th' incarnate God, ascended,
Pleads the merit of His blood;
Venture on Him, venture wholly,
Let no other trust intrude:
None but Jesus (2x)
Can do helpless sinners good.
Be glorified O Lord Jesus
Your name is above every other name
Who can compare to You Lord
You are wonderful our God.
When I look at the sun, and the moon,
Shining stars and the rainbow,
I am so amazed,
When I think that You made them, oh my Lord.
When I look at the hills, and the sea,
The forest, and animals,
I am so amazed,
When I think that they all belong to You.
You left Your throne above, Your greatness,
Your majesty, Your splendour
You came and died for me, on the cross
I am grateful for Your love
You overcame the world and satan
Death has lost his power
You are risen and reign over
Cherubim and seraphim.
Today, Your one desire, Your burden,
It's to save every sinner,
Your arms are wide opened,
And You call the whole world to the cross.
And while You stretch Your hand,
In the world, oh, remember Cameroon,
Come in this nation to save
Oh, please come, Lord Jesus.
Celebrate and praise His name,
Clap for Him, sing a song of praise,
Shout for Him, shout with joy,
He is worthy, O our Lord.

hymns.title: Faith of Our Fathers
hymns.author: Frederick William Faber. 1814-1863.

lines: Faith of our fathers, living still
In spite of dungeon, fire, and sword,
Oh, how our hearts beat high with joy
Whene'er we hear that glorious word.
Faith of our fathers, holy faith!
We will be true to thee till death.
Our fathers, chained in prisons dark,
Were still in heart and conscience free;
And blest would be their children's fate,
Though they, like them, should die for Thee.
Faith of our fathers! God's great power
Shall soon all nations win for Thee;
And through the truth that comes from God
Mankind shall then indeed be free.
Faith of our fathers! we will love
Both friend and foe in all our strife,
And preach Thee, too, as love knows how,
By kindly words and virtuous life:
